title: Voice and overlay announce the lane opponent's completed items by default
problem: trackOpponent() logs each newly completed opponent item and, with voiceEnemy (default true), speaks '<opp> har købt <item>'. The newest log entry is also pinned in the PiP overlay footer. This is a pushed, real-time alert about an enemy item spike, which the project's own research treats as forbidden under Overwolf's Riot rules. Only the level-6 half was removed.
fix: Set voiceEnemy to false by default, or remove the 'opp-item' speak call. Drop the plan.log entry from the overlay footer (gui.html:645) and keep enemy items as passive TAB-style data only. Fix the misleading config comment at line 36 too.
evidence: lol-helper.js:36 `voiceEnemy: true` (the comment still says 'eller når level 6'). Lines 512-516: add() pushes to plan.log and calls speak(kind, text) when cfg.voiceEnemy is set. Line 523: `add('opp-item', `${plan.opponent} har købt ${itemName(id)}`)`. speak() (1462-1463) checks only cfg.voice, which defaults to true (line 35). gui.html:645 overlay footer shows `${clock(s.plan.log[0].t)} ${s.plan.log[0].text}`. The code behaviour is verified. Two points remain uncertain: whether Riot or Overwolf actually classify a completed item as an 'enemy power spike' (I did not verify the rule text myself), and whether the Live Client API exposes the items exactly as TAB does. TAB shows enemy items, so it is probably not unknown info, but the push alert remains.

title: 'X er fed' is spoken and pinned in the overlay as an alert about enemy strength
problem: announce() speaks '<names> er fed' every time a new enemy crosses the program's own fed threshold, and voice is on by default. The overlay footer and a FED tag on the scoreboard show the same conclusion. 'Fed' is an inference from kills/deaths and a threat score, not a raw TAB fact, and it is pushed in real time.
fix: Remove the fed speak call (lines 1504-1505) and the fed tracking in app.voice. Replace the 'Fed:' overlay footer (gui.html:642) and the FED tag (gui.html:473) with neutral facts such as KDA, or remove them. Update the toolbar tooltip (gui.html:687), the config comment at line 35, and the voice/overlay paragraphs in README.md and LAES-MIG.txt.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1504-1505 `const newFed = [...fed].filter(...); if (newFed.length) speak('fed', `${newFed.join(' og ')} er fed`)`. Line 35 `voice: true`. Lines 1241-1243 define fed as kills-deaths>=3 && kills>=4, or threat>=1.4x average && kills>=3. gui.html:642 `'Fed: ' + L.enemy.fed.join(', ')`, gui.html:473 fedtag 'FED', gui.html:687 tooltip mentions 'X er fed'. docs/research-tryndamere-evelynn.md:46 itself flags this as close to 'Drawing conclusions for you during gameplay'. README 'Stemme og fuldskærm' and 'Overlay' sections also advertise it.

title: Build-order advice ignores Evelynn's Dark Seal core combos, so the shares are wrong and Mejai's never counts as a 'typical next item'
problem: nextInBuild (lol-helper.js:1297-1310) indexes ids[k], where k = the number of completed non-boots items, and drops any combo whose first k ids are not all owned. Evelynn's OP.GG core_items mostly start with Dark Seal 1082. isCompleted (line 1065-1066) needs into.length===0 && gold>=1500, and Dark Seal has into ['3041'] and costs 350 g, so it is never in `owned`. When Mejai's is completed it consumes the Dark Seal, so the 4-item core list from coreOf (line 427) can never reach 4/4 in announce (line 1486-1501) or in the gameplan 'Dit core build x/y' line (line 544-546).
fix: Normalize the combos before nextInBuild/coreOf/plan.myCore: drop ids that are not isCompleted (for example 1082), and dedupe when 3041 is already in the combo. Then base the k>=3 cutoff on the normalized length. Add a fixture with Dark Seal-led combos to the tests.
evidence: Fetched lol-api-champion.op.gg/api/euw/champions/ranked/28/JUNGLE: 15 combos, 8117 games, and 5484 of them contain 1082 as ids[0]. Top combo is [1082,3100,3041,3089] with 1527 games. Data Dragon 16.21.1 lists 1082 at 350 g with into ['3041']. With node I computed that combos with ids[0]===3100 are 2473/8117 = 30.5%, while Lich Bane is the first completed item in 98.0% of combos. That matches the reviewer's numbers exactly. At k=1 (Lich Bane owned) only the 2473 non-seal games pass the `ids.slice(0,k).every(owned.has)` filter, so Mejai's (index 2 in the top combo) gets no next-share. It falls through to 'Fast del af buildet' at line 1406. Severity is high because this skews the main Evelynn build path in every game, though Lich Bane is still recommended first.

title: Overlay, 'Ændringer', 'Lige nu' og stemmen giver notifikationer om modstanderens færdige items
problem: trackOpponent pusher '<modstander> har købt <item>' til plan.log (lol-helper.js:523). Det vises i overlayets fod (gui.html:644) og under 'Ændringer' (gui.html:302). planNow viser modstanderens core-fremdrift (lol-helper.js:547). Værre endnu: voiceEnemy er true som standard (lol-helper.js:36), så speak() siger det højt (516). Koden fjerner selv level 6-beskeden af præcis den policy-grund (526).
fix: Fjern de push-agtige beskeder om modstanderens items (overlay-foden, 'Ændringer', stemmen) og linjen med modstanderens core-fremdrift, eller gør dem opt-in og passive. Sæt voiceEnemy til false som standard. Ret README.md:80 og LAES-MIG.txt:15, som stadig nævner level 6.
evidence: Koden er bekræftet på lol-helper.js:36, 516, 523, 526 og 547 samt gui.html:302 og 644. At et færdigt item tæller som en 'power spike' under Overwolfs regler, er en fortolkning, som jeg ikke har tjekket mod regelteksten. Kodens egen kommentar på 526 og opgavens hårde krav peger dog i den retning. Research-dokumentet (linje 39) kalder item-alarmer om fjenden 'gråzone ... kun ren fakta, slå til selv', men her er de slået til som standard.

title: One failure at lock leaves the whole champ select without runes, spells or item set, and nothing retries it
problem: app.applied = {pickKey,itemKey} is set at 2111 before getBuild (2119). If getBuild throws, the error only reaches main()'s catch, which logs 'Fejl: ...' (2289-2291). The next tick sees identical keys (2221) and never calls handlePick again. If the enemy team later changes, the non-full path returns at 2121 because app.build is still null. applyRuneChoice (2136), applySpells (2138) and applyItems (2157) run in sequence with no per-step try/catch, so a failed rune POST also skips spells and the item set. tick sets 'Champion select - build sat.' (2217) before handlePick runs.
fix: Set app.applied only after success, or clear app.applied.pickKey after a failure with a capped number of retries and a short backoff. Wrap runes, spells and the item set in separate try/catch blocks. Show the 'build sat.' status only after success.
evidence: Checked lol-helper.js:2100-2158 (handlePick), 2215-2229 (tick) and 2285-2293 (main loop catch). The comment at 2110 shows this is deliberate ('rolle-knappen i vinduet prøver igen'). That retry exists: /api/role sets app.applied.pickKey = null (1999-2000). The README does not describe it as a retry, and a user would not know to use it. cachedJson deletes a failed entry (288-291), so a retry would refetch instead of reusing the cached failure. applyRunes throws without deleting anything when our own page exists (746), so a rune error goes straight up and spells/items are skipped. The ARAM claim (theirTeam hidden, so no second pass) is uncertain because it depends on real client data, but the core bug does not depend on it.

title: Enemy item-completion callouts are on by default: an enemy power-spike notification, and the docs still promise level 6
problem: trackOpponent speaks '<opp> har købt <item>' for every newly completed enemy item when cfg.voiceEnemy is true. That flag defaults to true and has no GUI toggle. The latest entry is also always shown in the overlay footer. The level-6 callout was removed for the power-spike reason, but item completion was left in. The line 36 comment, README:80 and LAES-MIG.txt:15 still promise level 6.
fix: Default voiceEnemy to false, or remove the spoken enemy-item callout and keep it only in the main window's Ændringer log, not the always-on-top overlay. Fix the stale level-6 text in lol-helper.js:36, README.md:80 and LAES-MIG.txt:15-16.
evidence: lol-helper.js:36 `voiceEnemy: true, // ... eller når level 6`. lol-helper.js:512-524: add() calls speak('opp-item') when cfg.voiceEnemy is set, and line 524 comments that level 6 is deliberately not announced because of Riot/Overwolf. A grep of gui.html for 'voiceEnemy' finds nothing, so there is no toggle. gui.html:647 renders s.plan.log[0] in the overlay. README.md:80 and LAES-MIG.txt:15 still mention level 6. The code facts are verified. Whether item completion counts as a 'power spike' under Overwolf is an interpretation: the item is visible on TAB. Still, a proactive spoken alert matches the forbidden pattern and contradicts the codebase's own reasoning at line 524.

title: Gunmetal Greaves (tier-3 Berserker's) not seen as boots: re-suggests Berserker's, never reaches a full build
problem: isCompleted (lol-helper.js:1065-1066) only counts Boots-tagged items as finished boots. Gunmetal Greaves (3172) has no Boots tag and costs 1100 g, so it fails the gold >= 1500 rule and counts as an unfinished component. hasBoots in liveAdvice (1332) and in inventoryInfo (1142) are both false, Berserker's Greaves gets suggested again, and a 6-item build with Gunmetal is never 'full'.
fix: Add an isBoots(it) helper: it.tags.includes('Boots') or any item in the it.from chain is boots. Use it in isCompleted, 1142, 1332, 1349 and 1352.
evidence: Fetched DDragon 16.21.1 (the current version). 3172 Gunmetal Greaves has tags [AttackSpeed, LifeSteal, NonbootsMovement], gold.total 1100, depth 3, from [3006], no into. A scan of every item shows Gunmetal is the only item built from boots that lacks the Boots tag. The loader (lol-helper.js:208-224) keeps tags/into/gold as they are. In liveAdvice, remainingCost(3006) does not subtract Gunmetal because 3172 is not in 3006.from, so Berserker's shows at the full 1100 g. OP.GG Tryndamere top: Berserker's 82% of boots. Not verified: that the Live Client API reports Gunmetal as itemID 3172 (very likely, since all other IDs match DDragon). How serious this is depends on players actually upgrading to tier 3 late in the game.

title: Owning Executioner's Calling / Oblivion Orb hides Mortal Reminder / Morellonomicon
problem: hasAntiheal = owned.some(id => dd.items[id]?.antiheal) also matches components. Line 1374 then drops every anti-heal item from scoring, including the finished item that the component builds into. The in-progress bonus (800 g >= IN_PROGRESS_GOLD 700) never applies, because the filter runs before scoring.
fix: hasAntiheal = completedOwned.some(id => dd.items[id].antiheal). completedOwned has to be computed before this line (it is currently computed on line 1337).
evidence: DDragon 16.21.1: 3123 Executioner's Calling (800 g) and 3916 Oblivion Orb (800 g) both match /Grievous Wounds/, the antiheal regex at lol-helper.js:212. 3033 Mortal Reminder is built from 3123, and 3165 Morellonomicon from 3916. Line 1374 runs 'continue' before remainingCost/inProgress at 1377-1379. The poolHasAntiheal/fallback block (1359-1366) also requires !hasAntiheal, so it does not help. OP.GG Tryndamere core combos contain Mortal Reminder (for example Hydra + PD + Mortal Reminder).

title: No internet at startup (autostart at Windows login) crashes the whole program
problem: main() awaits loadStaticData() before it starts the window server or any loop. There is no retry and no disk cache. If any of the 5 Data Dragon fetches throws (15 s timeout each), main().catch exits the process.
fix: Retry loadStaticData with backoff and start the window server first with a 'Venter på internet' status. Also cache the last Data Dragon payload on disk and use it as a fallback.
evidence: lol-helper.js:2261 `const ddVersion = await loadStaticData();` runs before startWindowServer (2264), liveLoop (2273) and the tick loop (2281). loadStaticData (195-202) has no try/catch, and getJson (187-190) uses a 15 s timeout and throws on !ok. main().catch (2302-2306) calls process.exit(1) after 30 s when IS_SEA and at once otherwise. The Startup shortcut adds --autostart (1838), which sets openWindow=false (2242), so the user sees nothing. The unhandledRejection handler (2298) does not help, because main's rejection is handled by .catch. Whether Wi-Fi is really down at login on this PC is environment-dependent, but any Data Dragon outage or timeout at start triggers the same exit.

title: Anti-heal detection misses Thornmail, Chempunk Chainsword and Bramble Vest (Riot renamed the effect to 'Wounds')
problem: `antiheal: /Grievous Wounds/.test(it.description)` is false for the SR items 3075 Thornmail, 6609 Chempunk Chainsword and 3076 Bramble Vest in DDragon 16.21.1, so every anti-heal check misses them: planNow line 556, counterItems line 638, and liveAdvice lines 1333, 1359-1364, 1374, 1387 and 1437.
fix: Use /\bWounds\b/ (plus an optional ID allow-list fallback). Small correction to the reviewer: on maps[11], /\bWounds\b/ also matches 323075, a mode-variant Thornmail, so the claim 'nothing else' is slightly wrong. It is harmless. Add a test against the real item.json.
evidence: Fetched DDragon 16.21.1 item.json. /Grievous Wounds/ gives 3075=false, 6609=false, 3076=false, and 3033/3165/3123/3916/3011=true. /\bWounds\b/ is true for all of them. SR matches for \bWounds\b: 3011, 3033, 3075, 3076, 3123, 3165, 3916, 6609, 323075. The code paths at lines 556, 638, 1333, 1359-1374 and 1387 all read only it.antiheal (checked by grep). Line 1333: hasAntiheal is false with Chempunk, so line 1374 does not skip Mortal Reminder and line 1387 adds the anti-heal score.

title: Gunmetal Greaves (Tryndamere's tier-3 boots) is not seen as boots or as a completed item, so the app tells him to buy boots again
problem: In DDragon 16.21.1, 3172 Gunmetal Greaves has tags [AttackSpeed, LifeSteal, NonbootsMovement] with no Boots tag, depth 3, total 1100 and into []. isCompleted (lines 1065-1066) takes the non-boots branch and requires gold>=1500, so it returns false. inventoryInfo line 1142 (hasBoots from completed) and liveAdvice line 1332 (tags Boots) both get hasBoots=false. 3006 is not in owned (the player holds 3172), so line 1372 does not exclude it and Berserker's is offered again. The boots reminder fires after 10 min.
fix: Add a derived boots flag in loadStaticData: the Boots tag, or a recursive check whether any `from` component is boots. Use it at lines 627, 1066, 1142, 1332, 1342, 1349, 1352 and 1373. Optionally also treat an owned upgrade as owning its `from` base boots. Add a test with 3172.
evidence: DDragon 16.21.1: 3172 tags=[AttackSpeed, LifeSteal, NonbootsMovement], depth 3, gold.total 1100, from [3006]. 3006 has tags [AttackSpeed, Boots] and into [3172]. 3168/3170/3171/3173/3174/3175 all include 'Boots'. Code read: lines 1065-1066, 1139-1144, 1332, 1372-1373. Not verified: how often players actually own 3172 in real games (OP.GG pick rate not checked), and that the Live Client reports the upgraded ID 3172. The latter is very likely.

title: Dark Seal breaks build-order inference: Mejai's never shows up as the 'typical next item', and core progress can't reach 4/4
problem: nextInBuild (1289-1302) matches combos by position, with k = completed non-boots items owned. Dark Seal (1082) is never completed (isCompleted at 1065: gold 350, into [3041]). So after the first completed item, every combo that starts with 1082 is dropped. coreOf (433) takes core_items[0] raw, which is [1082,3100,3041,3089]. announce (1486-1487) only counts completed core items, so the most it can say is '3 af 4'. planNow (543-544) counts Dark Seal until it turns into Mejai's, so it also tops out at 3/4. The reviewer's game counts don't match the GLOBAL data I fetched, but the mechanism is the same.
fix: In nextInBuild and coreOf, filter each combo down to completed items (ids.filter(id => isCompleted(dd.items[id]))) and merge combos that become identical. Show Dark Seal on its own as an early-buy line instead of a core slot.
evidence: I fetched OP.GG global ranked/28/jungle?version=16.20, which is the patch the app falls back to because 16.21 has only 197 games, below THIN_PATCH_GAMES. core_items: 16860 of 25940 games start with 1082. core_items[0] = 1082,3100,3041,3089. I simulated nextInBuild: with k=0 the counts are {1082:16860, 3100:8480, 3041:600}, but 1082 is skipped in liveAdvice (1372, !isCompleted), so Lich's reason reads 'Typisk 1. item (33%)'. With k=1 and owning [3100], total is 8480 and the counts are {3089:5432, 4645:3048}, so Mejai's (3041) gets 0, even though it follows 1082+3100 in about 6000 games. Mejai's is completed (DDragon 16.21.1: 1500 g, no into), so the cap at 3/4 in announce and planNow holds.

title: Doran's Bow/Helm og Control Ward kan ikke sælges: fyldte pladser giver få eller ingen købsforslag
problem: SELLABLE_STARTERS (1134) indeholder 1054/1055/1056/1082/1083, men ikke Doran's Bow 1086 eller Doran's Helm 1120. Begge findes i Data Dragon 16.21.1 som Lane-starters. Control Ward (2055, Consumable) tæller i slotsUsed (1105, slot<6), men ikke som completed (isCompleted 1065 udelukker Consumable). Derfor bliver full=false (1338/1140), freeSlots=0 (1339) og sellable=[] (1344). Hvert item uden ejede dele springes over ved 1418-1420, og hverken swap (kræver full) eller elixir (1153, kræver full) kan træde i stedet.
fix: Tilføj '1086' og '1120' til SELLABLE_STARTERS. Behandl 2055 og potions (Consumable i slot<6) som noget der kan frigøre en plads. Definér 'full' som slotsUsed>=6 && completed>=5, så både swap og elixir virker, når den sjette plads er en ward.
evidence: Læst 1065-1066, 1105, 1134, 1138-1153, 1336-1347, 1412-1424. DDragon 16.21.1: 1086 Doran's Bow (sell 160) og 1120 Doran's Helm (sell 180) mangler i settet. 2055 har tags [Consumable, ...]. OP.GG GLOBAL TOP 16.21: Doran's Bow+2 pots er starter #1 (47,4%). Ironisk nok anbefaler wardTip (1149) selv at købe den Control Ward, der derefter blokerer rådene. Tilfældet med 5 færdige items + ward: nonBootsDone>=3, så nextInBuild=null, og alle items uden dele bliver filtreret væk -> tom liste. Det er bekræftet ved at følge koden. De konkrete OP.GG-tal (16.20) i findingen har jeg ikke genkørt.

title: Doran's Blade/Bow, Vampiric Scepter og Elixir of Wrath gør modstandere til 'healere'
problem: livePlayer.healing er true, så snart et item har tagget LifeSteal eller SpellVamp. DDragon 16.21.1: Doran's Blade har [LifeSteal, SpellVamp], Doran's Bow har [SpellVamp], Vampiric Scepter har [LifeSteal] og Elixir of Wrath har [LifeSteal, SpellVamp]. enemy.healers (1249) giver +30+15*n til anti-heal (1387). Det tæller som en 'adapted'-grund og får dermed en af de garanterede pladser (1453). Uden rigtige healere slår fallback-anti-heal-blokken (1359-1366) også til.
fix: Lad kun færdige items tælle (isCompleted) i healing-tjekket, eller brug en kort liste over sustain-items. Starters, komponenter og elixirer skal ikke tælle.
evidence: Læst 1109, 1249, 1358-1366, 1387, 1453, og tags tjekket i DDragon item.json 16.21.1. Næsten alle ADC'er og mange top-laners starter med Doran's Blade/Bow, så healers er ikke-tom fra minut 1 i de fleste kampe. I selve Darius-scenariet er Darius allerede i HEALERS (48), så Jinx' Doran's lægger kun +15 oven i. At Mortal Reminder (pop 14,6% i last_items på 16.21) dermed kommer over Hydra, afhænger af 16.20-tallene, som jeg ikke har genberegnet. Selve mekanismen er bekræftet. planNow (557) bruger me.healing, men for Tryndamere er det uden betydning, fordi han står i HEALERS.

title: Buy reasons say 'X er fed (KDA) og laver AD/AP-skade', a conclusion rather than a fact
problem: liveAdvice adds the reason '<champ> er fed (<kda>) og laver AD-skade' (and an AP version). It appears in the window's reason list and often as the overlay's one-line reason. enemyLiveCard also lists 'Fed: ...'. The other reasons (bygger armor, anti-heal, AD share) are worded as data.
fix: Reword as a fact, e.g. '<champ> <kda> - mest AD-skade blandt modstanderne'. Rename or remove the 'Fed' line in enemyLiveCard (gui.html:455).
evidence: lol-helper.js:1392-1393 push those strings. gui.html:444 renders all reasons. gui.html:640 shows the first reason that does not start with 'Du er i gang'. gui.html:455 `line('Fed', e.fed)`. The severity is lower than the voice finding because these lines are passive, not pushed.

title: User guide and README still promise level 6 / 'har ult' notifications that the code removed
problem: LAES-MIG.txt and README describe 'hvem der har ult' in 'Lige nu' and a level 6 voice/log entry. The code deliberately removed both, and README.md:74 says it did. The docs contradict themselves, and README describes a forbidden feature that a Riot reviewer would read.
fix: Rewrite LAES-MIG.txt:12-16, README.md:79-80 and the config comment at lol-helper.js:36 to match the code. Also update them if the enemy-item voice is removed.
evidence: LAES-MIG.txt:12-16 ('level (og hvem der har ult)', 'Når han køber et item eller når level 6, kommer det i "Ændringer" og stemmen siger det'). README.md:79 'level og hvem der har ult'. README.md:80 'hans nye færdige items og level 6 logges ... og siges højt'. README.md:74 says there are no such notifications. lol-helper.js:525 and :538 confirm the removal; planNow pushes only 'Level: dig X, n Y'. lol-helper.js:36 comment still says 'eller når level 6'.

title: OP.GG tip, 'Spillestil' and 'din bedste chance er før 25 min' remain on screen during the live game
problem: gameplanCard is rendered in the live view as well as in champ select. planView always includes playStyle, tip and scaling, with no live check. The scaling sentence is prescriptive, and the research doc marks in-game tips as a grey zone leaning to not allowed.
fix: Leave playStyle, tip and scaling out of planView when app.live is set, or hide them in gameplanCard during live. Alternatively word the scaling as win-rate-by-game-length data.
evidence: gui.html:501 calls gameplanCard(s.plan) inside the live layout, and gui.html:576 is the champ-select layout. gui.html:295-298 render chip('Spillestil'), the tip blockquote and p.scaling unconditionally. lol-helper.js:1681-1700 planView has no app.live gate for these fields. lol-helper.js:445 `din bedste chance i kampen er før 25 min.` docs/research-tryndamere-evelynn.md:43 says 'AI-tips under kampen | Gråzone→ikke tilladt'. Uncertain: the actual OP.GG tip texts were not fetched, and they are static pre-game guide text rather than live-reactive, which weakens the 'dictate decisions' argument somewhat.

title: Ingen rollback hvis den nye version crasher efter spawn - og .old slettes tidligt af den nye
problem: Rollback sker kun ved child 'error' (1033-1040). Efter 'spawn' lukker den gamle version altid serveren og kalder process.exit(0) efter 300 ms (1042-1047), uden at tjekke at den nye kom op. Værre end rapporteret: den nye version sletter exe.old som noget af det første i main (fs.rm ved ca. linje 2243, før loadStaticData og startWindowServer). Crasher den efter det, fx hvis loadStaticData fejler eller listen fejler, findes der ingen .old at rulle tilbage til, heller ikke manuelt.
fix: Lad den gamle version vente på et sundhedstjek: poll /state, indtil version === app.update.version og pid === child.pid, med timeout på ca. 20-30 sek. Ellers dræb child, rollback() og genstart den gamle. Flyt også sletningen af .old i den nye version, så den først sker efter vellykket listen, eller lad den gamle version stå for oprydningen.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1031-1047 (spawn-promise, derefter ubetinget server.close + exit). Linje ca. 2243: `if (IS_SEA) fs.rm(`${process.execPath}.old`...)` kører før loadStaticData/setupRemote/startWindowServer. main().catch (ca. 2303) holder kun konsolvinduet åbent i 30 sek. og afslutter så. Om en rigtig fejl i opstarten opstår, kan ikke verificeres uden en reel release. Mekanismen i koden er bekræftet.

title: Telefon-adgang: ukrypteret HTTP på alle interfaces med token der aldrig roterer
problem: Med remoteAccess lyttes på 0.0.0.0 (2057). remoteUrls (1910-1920) laver http://<ip>:port/?token=... for alle ikke-interne IPv4-adresser. Cookien (1953) er HttpOnly og SameSite=Strict, men ikke Secure, og har Max-Age 1 år. Token'et (1900-1907) gemmes i remote-token.txt og fornyes kun, når filen slettes. Sammenligningen bruger ikke timingSafeEqual (1951, 1956).
fix: Standard: kun Tailscale-adressen, og LAN kun via et eksplicit valg. Rotationsknap kun fra loopback. Kortere levetid for cookien. timingSafeEqual er en mindre ting.
evidence: Læst 1895-1960 og 2050-2060. Afgrænsning: det er opt-in (remoteAccess, LAES-MIG.txt:121). /api/update og /api/autostart er loopback-only (2012 m.fl.). Windows-firewallen spørger, og LAES-MIG anbefaler kun private netværk, hvilket begrænser eksponering på offentlige netværk. På et delt wifi er passiv aflytning af token'et dog reel, så medium er rimeligt for en opt-in-funktion.

title: Toggling 'Stemme' wipes config.json when the file has a BOM or a JSON typo
problem: saveConfigValue swallows a parse error (`catch {}`) and writes back only {[key]: value}. loadConfig (64-71) has already fallen back to defaults with only a log line. The only caller is POST /api/voice (2021-2024), so one click on 'Stemme' replaces the user's whole config with {"voice":...}. JSON.parse does not accept U+FEFF as whitespace (ECMA-404), and readFileSync 'utf8' keeps the BOM.
fix: Strip a leading ﻿ in both loadConfig and saveConfigValue. If parsing the existing file fails, do not write; log that the setting was not saved.
evidence: lol-helper.js:64-71 (loadConfig fallback), 74-79 (saveConfigValue with `catch {}` then write), 2021-2024 (the only call site, voice toggle). LAES-MIG.txt:122 and 128 tell the user to edit config.json by hand. I lowered severity to medium: Windows 11 Notepad saves UTF-8 without a BOM by default, so the realistic triggers are a typo such as a trailing comma or a PowerShell 5 save. Data loss is real but only happens after a voice toggle. My node check of JSON.parse with a BOM was blocked by the sandbox, so the BOM claim rests on spec behaviour.

title: 'LÆS MIG.txt' is stored without the UTF-8 flag in the Windows zip and shows as 'L├åS MIG.txt'
problem: Info-ZIP `zip -qry` on macOS stores the name as raw UTF-8 bytes with flag_bits 0x0 and no 0x7075 Unicode-path extra field. Windows Explorer decodes unflagged names with the OEM code page, so the name comes out garbled.
fix: Build the zip with Python zipfile (sets 0x800 for non-ASCII names) or with `ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent`, then check that flag 0x800 is set. Alternatively name the file LAES-MIG.txt.
evidence: scripts/build.sh:58 (cp to "$dir/LÆS MIG.txt") and :60 (zip -qry). I opened dist/LoL-Rune-Helper-Windows.zip with python zipfile: the entry 'LoL-Rune-Helper-Windows/L├åS MIG.txt' has flag_bits 0x0 and only a 0x5455 (timestamp) extra field. Python's cp437 fallback already shows the mojibake. The exact rendering in Explorer on CP850 was not tested on Windows.

title: Voice callouts overlap: each speak() starts its own PowerShell, and several kinds can fire in one pass
problem: The throttle is per kind only (lastSpoken, 1465-1466). announce() can call speak for start, afford, skill, core (in a loop, which is itself throttled after the first) and fed in one pass (1490-1505). On Windows each call is a separate powershell.exe with Add-Type plus a synchronous Speak (1472-1474), so the voices play at the same time and each call pays a PowerShell cold start.
fix: Use a single speech queue: one long-lived PowerShell/SpeechSynthesizer reading lines from stdin, or a JS queue that starts the next utterance only when the previous process exits and drops items older than a few seconds.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1462-1478 (speak), 1490-1505 (announce issues afford/skill/core/fed in sequence with no global gate), 117 (comment: PowerShell costs about 0.5 s of CPU to start). Audible overlap on a real PC is not tested, but the code places no limit across kinds.

title: (Uncertain) Danish callouts are probably read by an English SAPI voice, and speech errors are silent
problem: System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer is used with the default voice and no culture is selected. It only lists SAPI5 desktop voices. Whether a da-DK voice is visible to it on Tobias' PC cannot be checked here. The callback `done = () => {}` (1468) discards every error, so a missing voice or a PowerShell failure leaves no trace in the log.
fix: Select a da-DK voice when one exists (SelectVoiceByHints with culture da-DK, with fallback) or use WinRT Windows.Media.SpeechSynthesis. Log the chosen voice once and pass speak errors to log().
evidence: lol-helper.js:1468 (no-op callback), 1472-1474 (default voice, no SelectVoice). The voice-availability part depends on Windows and was not verified. The swallowed-error part is confirmed in code.

title: After a self-update the new version runs with no visible console and its stdout goes to NUL; the .old cleanup races the old process
problem: applyUpdate spawns the new exe with detached:true and stdio:'ignore', then exits the old one after 300 ms (1031, 1043). As far as I know, libuv on Windows uses DETACHED_PROCESS for detached children, which means no console window. Either way stdout is ignored, and there is no Windows log file (lol-helper.log exists only in the macOS launchd plist, 1857-1858). There is no quit endpoint in the GUI (grep for quit/afslut found nothing relevant). Separately, the new process runs fs.rm on `<exe>.old` at startup (2243) while the old process is still running from that file, so on Windows the delete fails silently and the .old file stays until a later start.
fix: On win32, relaunch through `cmd /c start "" "<exe>" --updated` so the new version gets a normal console, or add a log file. Retry the .old delete after a few seconds. Consider a loopback-only 'Luk programmet' button.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1031 (spawn detached + stdio ignore), 1039-1043 (old process closes and exits after 300 ms), 2243 (immediate .old removal, callback ignores errors), 2238-2239 (with --updated, openWindow=false). The console visibility depends on libuv/Windows behaviour and is not tested here, so the verdict is plausible. The stdout loss and the .old race follow from the code.

title: Jungler with 5 completed items + pet gets no item advice and no elixir
problem: Pets 1101-1103 and 1105-1107 have tag 'Jungle' and cost 450 g, so isCompleted is false for them. liveAdvice sets full = completedOwned.length >= 6 (line 1337), while freeSlots = 6 - slotsUsed = 0 (line 1339). The pet is not in SELLABLE_STARTERS (line 1131). So every candidate without owned components hits `if (!sellable.length) continue;` (line 1417), and liveAdvice returns []. inventoryInfo has the same full check (line 1141), so elixir is null. The Dark Seal exception at line 1343 also keeps 1082 unsellable when Mejai's is in the pool.
fix: Treat a held jungle pet (tag 'Jungle') as part of the full state: full = completed + pets >= 6, in both inventoryInfo and liveAdvice. Or offer it as a sell/swap candidate when dd sell > 0. Add a test with 5 items + pet.
evidence: Read lol-helper.js:1065-1066 (isCompleted), 1105 (slotsUsed counts every slot < 6, so the pet counts), 1131, 1140-1141 and 1336-1345, 1413-1420. Data Dragon 16.21.1: 1101-1103 have sell 0, 1105-1107 have sell 180, all tagged ['Jungle']. The code path is certain. Whether the pet can be sold in the real game, and which ID the Live Client reports, is not verified. I rate it medium rather than high: it only affects late game (5 completed items) and leaves the card empty instead of giving wrong advice.

title: A failed jungle-route fetch is never retried in that game
problem: ensureJungleRoutes sets app.jungleKey = championKey (line 416) before fetching. The .catch only logs (line 423). Every later call from handlePick (line 2129) and updateLive (line 1535) returns early on `app.jungleKey === championKey`. Only clearPick (line 932-933) resets it. Separately, a null result from parseJungleRoutes is written to the file cache by cachedJson (line 281-284) and served for 6 hours.
fix: In the catch and when the result is null, reset app.jungleKey (with a 30-60 s backoff timestamp). In the loader, throw instead of returning null, so cachedJson's catch removes the entry and nothing is written to disk.
evidence: Read lol-helper.js:273-292 (cachedJson writes whatever the loader returns and deletes the memory entry only on throw), 401-424, 926-934, 1535, 2129. The 'queue busy' part of the scenario is not a failure: limited() only delays. A failure needs a timeout or a non-OK status. Medium, because there is no recovery path at all, though it needs a transient error to trigger.

title: 'DIN TUR TIL AT BANNE' vises ikke, når banfasen starter uden andre ændringer
problem: updateDraft sætter app.draft.myBanTurn (876) og returnerer ved 877, når key er uændret, uden broadcast(). tick() (2203-2208) broadcaster kun via setStatus, og den er idempotent (1881-1885). Der er ingen periodisk broadcast i champ select. Derfor når GUI'en (gui.html:463) først at se myBanTurn ved en senere, uafhængig broadcast. .then (882) gemmer også den myBanTurn, der blev fanget, da kaldet startede.
fix: Broadcast når myBanTurn ændrer sig, også når key er uændret. I .then skal den aktuelle værdi af app.draft.myBanTurn bruges, ikke den fangede. Udvid testen, så banfasen slås til, efter at draften er sat.
evidence: lol-helper.js:874-884: key består kun af position, enemyIds og unavailable (bans tæller kun med, når de er completed). setStatus på 1881 returnerer tidligt ved samme besked. Kode-delen er bekræftet. Om banneret dukker op 'senere' afhænger af den rigtige klient: hvis en holdkammerat låser sin ban først, ændrer unavailable sig, og så kommer en broadcast via .then. Bannere kan altså komme sent eller aldrig. Severity er sat ned fra high, fordi League-klienten selv viser, at det er din tur til at banne.

title: 'Opdater nu' bliver aktiv igen under download og kan starte to samtidige opdateringer
problem: onclick ændrer kun DOM-noden. applyUpdate kalder log() (lol-helper.js:1011), log broadcaster (61), og render() (gui.html:549) bygger så en ny, aktiv knap, fordi s.update stadig er sat. I kamp sker det også hvert 2. sekund via liveLoop. /api/update (lol-helper.js:2011-2018) har ingen spærre mod samtidige kald.
fix: Tilføj et app.updating-flag i /api/update, der giver 409, hvis det allerede er sat, og som ryddes i catch. Send update.inProgress med i viewModel, og lad GUI'en vise 'Opdaterer...' ud fra det.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1008-1045: to parallelle kørsler kan begge nå rmSync(.old) og renameSync(exe -> .old) (1023-1024). Den anden kan så slette eller overskrive den gamle exe eller fejle med ENOENT, og rollback (1019-1021) mister sin backup. Kræver dobbeltklik under en download, der kan tage op til 300 s (1012). Klikket virker kun lokalt (LOOPBACK, 2012). Severity er sat ned til medium.

title: Hele siden bygges om hvert 2. sekund i kamp: tooltips, fokus, scroll og blink forsvinder
problem: render() kalder $app.replaceChildren(), og renderOverlay erstatter body. liveLoop broadcaster hvert 2. sekund (lol-helper.js:1540, 1545), og gameTime ændrer sig hver gang, så dedupliceringen på lastJson (gui.html:698) rammer aldrig. Item-navne findes kun som img title (gui.html:204). Klassen flash forsvinder ved næste besked, fordi trackAffordable (gui.html:658-664) gør justAffordable tom, mens animationen varer 3 x 1,2 s (gui.html:128).
fix: Opdatér sektionerne enkeltvis ud fra hver sektions egen JSON, eller brug en morph-diff. Lad flash blive siddende pr. id, indtil animationen er slut.
evidence: gui.html:549-550, 649-654, 658-664, 696-705 og lol-helper.js:1540 er tjekket. Log-scrollen nulstilles, fordi <pre> bygges forfra. Om <details> forbliver åben, styres kun på 700/705.

title: Overlayet står frosset med gammelt guld og 'RÅD NU', når SSE-forbindelsen ryger, og teksten 'Programmet er lukket' er misvisende
problem: es.onerror udskifter kun $app og kalder ikke renderOverlay. PiP-vinduet viser derfor den sidste tilstand, indtil en ny besked kommer. Er programmet nede for alvor, står overlayet med gamle tal på ubestemt tid. Teksten 'Programmet er lukket' vises ved enhver SSE-fejl.
fix: Kald renderOverlay med en 'Forbindelse tabt - genforbinder...'-tilstand i onerror. Vis en neutral tekst om genforbindelse, og skriv først 'lukket' efter flere fejl i træk.
evidence: gui.html:706-711. renderOverlay (649-654) kaldes kun fra onmessage (703) og openOverlay. lastState nulstilles ikke. Ved opdatering lukker serveren selv alle SSE-klienter (lol-helper.js:1042), og så vises 'lukket' midlertidigt.

title: Gameplan from the previous matchup or champion stays on screen when the new pick has no lane opponent
problem: handlePick calls ensurePlan only when app.rec.matchup is set, and nothing else clears app.plan or app.planKey during champ select. The fullApply block (2112-2118) resets build, rec, runeIndex, appliedSpells and appliedPerks, but not plan or planKey. app.plan is cleared only in clearPick (926-933), which runs when champ select ends or the game finishes. planView (1681-1701) never compares p.myKey with app.pick. So after a champion trade, or after /api/role (1996-2001 sets applied.pickKey=null), the old 'Gameplan mod Darius' card with Tryndamere's core stays visible.
fix: Add else { app.plan = null; app.planKey = null; } after line 2128, and reset plan/planKey in the fullApply block. Optionally have planView return null when app.pick exists and String(app.pick.championId) !== p.myKey.
evidence: Read lol-helper.js:2100-2129 (no else, no plan reset), 492-505 (ensurePlan returns early on missing oppKey, keeps old plan until the new one resolves), 926-933 (the only reset), 1681-1701 (planView has no identity check), 1762 (state.plan = planView()), 2169-2172 (findMatchup returns null when laneOpponent finds nobody >= 0.25). Live play is less affected: analyzeLive 1263 gates the plan by oppKey, and line 1534 rebuilds it from the live opponent. The stale oppKey is used as the knownOpp fallback at 1256 only when position is missing. I lowered severity from high to medium because the effect is a stale display in champ select that fixes itself once an opponent is found or champ select ends.

title: scalingNote treats null game_lengths rates as 0 and says 'I skalerer nogenlunde ens.' without any data
problem: curve() returns g[last].rate - g[0].rate. OP.GG returns rate:null for off-role data, and null - null === 0, so the null guard on line 443 never fires. The note then says the champions scale the same, or that one of them scales better, with no data behind it. The 'din bedste chance i kampen er før 25 min' wording also reads like a conclusion or instruction rather than a fact.
fix: Return null from curve() unless typeof first.rate and last.rate are both 'number'. Phrase the line as a fact (win rate under 25 min vs 40+ min) instead of 'din bedste chance'.
evidence: Fetched lol-api-champion.op.gg/api/EUW/champions/ranked/23/MID today: all 5 game_lengths have rate:null (average 0.5). buildPlan (453) fetches oppBuild for the opponent at MY position, so an off-role enemy hits exactly this case. The test at test/fake-lcu.test.js:300 only checks /skalerer/, which the fallback text also matches.

title: Voice alerts for enemy item completions are on by default, and the docs still promise level 6 / 'har ult' alerts
problem: DEFAULT_CONFIG sets voiceEnemy: true, and its comment still mentions level 6. trackOpponent (520-525) speaks '<opp> har købt <item>' for every completed item when voiceEnemy is on. The project's own research rates voice alerts about enemy items as a grey zone that the user should turn on themselves. README.md:79-80 and LAES-MIG.txt:12-16 still describe 'hvem der har ult' and level 6 alerts that the code removed on purpose (lol-helper.js:525 and 538 comments).
fix: Default voiceEnemy to false and keep the silent log entry. Update the line 36 comment, README.md:79-80 and LAES-MIG.txt:12-16 to drop the level 6 and ult wording.
evidence: lol-helper.js:36 voiceEnemy: true; 508-528 trackOpponent with speak() gated only by cfg.voiceEnemy; docs/research-tryndamere-evelynn.md:37 'Gråzone ... kun ren fakta, slå til selv'; README.md:79 'level og hvem der har ult', README.md:80 'nye færdige items og level 6 logges ... siges højt'; LAES-MIG.txt:12-16 'level (og hvem der har ult)' and 'når level 6'. planNow 538 and trackOpponent 525 explicitly avoid ult and level-6 messages.

title: PowerShell/WMI startes hvert 15. sekund hele dagen når League ikke kører
problem: Når klienten ikke kører, returnerer tick() 3000 ms (2186), og findClient() falder igennem til powershell.exe + Get-CimInstance (120-121) hvert 15. sekund (118). Lockfilen findes kun mens klienten kører, så det sker i hele den tid programmet kører uden League (autostart findes: --autostart, 1838/2242).
fix: Backoff på PowerShell-tjekket (15 -> 30 -> 60 -> 120 s, nulstil ved fund) og/eller gem den fundne installationsmappe og læg den forrest i lockfileCandidates. Et billigt tasklist-tjek før PowerShell er også en mulighed.
evidence: Læst lol-helper.js:105-132 og 2182-2187: app.client er null -> findClient() hver 3. s; lockfile-tjek (115) er gratis, men ved fejl kører PowerShell når der er gået 15 s (118-121). Ingen backoff ud over de 15 s. Autostart-sti bekræftet (1826-1838, 2242). Nedjusteret fra high til medium: kodens eget skøn er ~0,5 s CPU pr. start, altså ca. 3 % af én kerne i snit plus en kort top hvert 15. sek. Det er reelt spild, men ingen fejl. Den præcise CPU-pris på Windows er ikke målt (uverificeret).

title: Stemmen starter en ny PowerShell pr. besked - flere beskeder taler oven i hinanden
problem: speak() begrænser kun pr. kind (1465), og hver besked kører execFile('powershell.exe' ... System.Speech) uden kø (1472-1474). announce() kan i samme tick kalde speak('afford'), 'skill', 'core' og 'fed' (1498-1505), og trackOpponent kan kalde speak (516, kun når voiceEnemy er slået til). Så starter 2-4 PowerShell-processer, der taler samtidig.
fix: Én langlivet PowerShell, der læser linjer fra stdin og kalder Speak sekventielt, eller en kø i Node med højst én execFile ad gangen (næste starter i done-callback'en) og et lille loft på køen.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1461-1478: done = () => {} venter ikke på noget, og der er ingen global lås. 1495-1505: flere forskellige kinds i samme announce-kald. 'Level op' (1499) og 'Råd til' (1498) udløses naturligt i samme tick efter recall plus level. At Windows rent faktisk mixer to SpeechSynthesizer-processer oven i hinanden, er ikke testet på Windows, men hver proces bruger sin egen synthesizer og venter ikke på de andre.

title: Runer/summoners venter på matchup-opslag hos OP.GG, før de sættes
problem: handlePick awaiter findMatchup(pick) (2123), før applyRuneChoice(0) (2136) og applySpells (2138). findMatchup kalder laneOpponent (probes) og fetchBuild med target_champion (2175), og alt går gennem limited()-køen. Prefetch ved hover (2209-2214) henter kun basis-buildet.
fix: Sæt runer/spells/item-set straks ud fra basis-buildet. Kør findMatchup i baggrunden og brug den eksisterende opdateringssti (2142-2156 med autoPageUntouched) til at skifte til matchup-runer. Prefetch evt. matchup-buildet under hover, når laneOpponent er kendt.
evidence: Læst 2100-2180. Rækkefølgen er bekræftet: await findMatchup sker før applyRuneChoice. Nuance: laneOpponent-probes bruger samme cache-nøgle (region_ranked_id_MID) som draft-analysen (843/366), så de er typisk allerede cachet eller undervejs. I normaltilfældet er forsinkelsen derfor 1-2 OP.GG-kald (~0,5-1 s, målt ~0,5 s pr. kald, plus 422-kaldet fra previousPatch-fejlen). 15-30 s gælder kun, hvis OP.GG hænger, og afhænger af reel netværksadfærd. Severity medium, fordi det rammer kernefunktionen.

title: Runes and spells wait for the matchup fetch at lock, and that fetch shares the 4-request OP.GG queue with the draft probes
problem: In the full apply, await findMatchup(pick) (2123) runs before applyRuneChoice (2136) and applySpells (2138). findMatchup calls laneOpponent and then fetchBuild(..., target) with ?target_champion=. The hover prefetch at 2210-2213 never fetches that URL. fetchBuild's loader runs inside one limited() slot (cachedJson 279) and can make two sequential getJson calls with a 15 s timeout each (188, 309-314) when the patch is thin. limited() allows 4 concurrent requests in a FIFO queue (250-258), and that queue is shared with the draft's analyzeDraft work (pool probes, pool builds, counters) started by updateDraft while the pick is pending.
fix: Apply base runes and spells first with recommend(build, cfg, enemyIds, null). Then fetch the matchup and use the existing non-full swap path (2145-2155), which only replaces the page when it is untouched. Optionally prefetch the target build on hover once updateDraft knows the opponent.
evidence: Read 2122-2140, 2170-2181 (findMatchup), 365-377 (laneOpponent), 296-319 (fetchBuild), 250-258 (limited) and 806-843 (myChampionPool/analyzeDraft). Mitigations: laneOpponent's MID probes share cache keys with the draft probes, so they are usually already cached, and a disk-cache hit (274-276) skips limited() entirely. Only the uncached target fetch is reliably on the critical path. A failed target fetch is caught (2177-2179) and does not block runes. Worst case is about 30 s plus queue wait. Whether that runs past finalization depends on real client timing and is unverified.

title: When rune pages are full, a user page is deleted, and not the one the README promises
problem: The victim is editable.filter(p => !p.current).pop() || the current page (753), so the code prefers the last non-active custom page. README.md line 13 says 'erstattes din aktive side én gang'. The page is removed with DELETE (755), and the only notice is a log line (754). If GET /lol-perks/v1/inventory fails or has no numeric ownedPageCount (750-751), the code assumes the pages are full even when the POST failed for another reason.
fix: Make the README match the code, or replace the active page as documented. Before deleting, require evidence that the pages are really full: the inventory answered, or the error body says max pages. If the second POST fails, log the error clearly.
evidence: Read lol-helper.js:736-759 and README.md:13. The risky fallback only applies when no 'Auto:' page exists yet (746 rethrows if ours exists), i.e. the first run or after the user deletes it. That narrows the reviewer's 'invalid rune ID' scenario to the first time. What ownedPageCount counts in the real LCU is unverified (it never appears in fake-lcu tests per grep). If it also counts non-deletable preset pages, line 751 always throws and pages are never replaced. That fails safe but leaves no Auto page.

title: Ingen sundhedstjek eller tilbagerulning efter opdatering - en defekt udgivelse efterlader brugeren uden et fungerende program
problem: Den gamle version ruller kun tilbage, hvis spawn() udsender 'error' (linje 1032-1039). Når barnet er startet, lukker den gamle version altid efter 300 ms (linje 1044) og venter ikke på, at den nye svarer. Den nye version sletter `${execPath}.old` i main() (linje 2243), før loadStaticData() (2264) og listen (2266). Der findes ingen kode, der lægger .old tilbage efter et nedbrud ved start.
fix: Lad den gamle proces vente, til den nye har meldt sig (fx ved at polle /state på samme port, indtil pid er ny og version = den nye; samme mønster som test/update.test.js:14). Kommer der intet svar inden ~30-60 sek., dræbes barnet, rollback() kaldes, og den gamle bliver kørende med en fejl i banneret. Flyt sletningen af .old til efter listen, eller til næste normale start.
evidence: Læst lol-helper.js:1008-1045 (applyUpdate). 'started' afhænger kun af child 'spawn'/'error'. Ved 1040-1044 lukkes serveren og process.exit(0) kaldes efter 300 ms uden tjek af barnet. lol-helper.js:2243 kører fs.rm(.old) asynkront, før data hentes, og main().catch (2298-2302) holder kun konsollen åben i 30 sek. grep fandt ingen anden genskabelse af .old. Severity sat ned fra high til medium: build.sh/update.test.js starter den færdige binær før udgivelse, så en binær, der crasher ved hver start, ville normalt blive fanget. Den reelle risiko er nedbrud, der afhænger af miljøet (fx Windows-specifikke fejl, netværk eller Data Dragon), og her er udvejen at hente zip-filen igen manuelt. Om Windows låser den kørende .old, så sletningen fejler, er ikke verificeret.

title: Knappen 'Opdater nu' bliver aktiv igen under download, så applyUpdate kan køre flere gange samtidig
problem: Knappen deaktiveres kun i DOM'en (gui.html:235). applyUpdate kalder straks log('Henter version ...') (lol-helper.js:1011). log() kalder broadcast() (56-62), og viewModel indeholder log: logLines.slice(-12) (1750), så SSE-dataene ændrer sig. Dermed rammes tjekket lastJson-tjekket (gui.html:698) ikke, og render() (548-552) bygger updateBanner op igen med en aktiv 'Opdater nu'-knap. /api/update (2011-2019) og applyUpdate har ingen vagt mod samtidige kørsler.
fix: Sæt app.updating = true i applyUpdate (eller i /api/update) og nulstil den i catch. Svar 409, hvis en opdatering allerede er i gang, og send updating med i viewModel (1759), så banneret viser 'Opdaterer...' uden knap.
evidence: lol-helper.js:56-62 (log->broadcast), 1750 (log i viewModel), 1759 (update i viewModel uden status), 2011-2019 (ingen vagt). gui.html:548-552 (replaceChildren + updateBanner) og 694-701 (render ved hver ny SSE-besked). Den præcise fejl ved et andet klik (EPERM på Windows) er ikke verificeret, men dobbelt download og et kapløb om rmSync/renameSync på .old/.new følger direkte af koden.

title: release.sh tjekker ikke, at de byggede filer har samme VERSION som tagget
problem: release.sh læser VERSION fra kildekoden (linje 8) og uploader dist/release/* uden at tjekke binærens VERSION, om arbejdskopien er committet, og uden at bruge draft. Hvis binæren er bygget før VERSION blev hævet, finder newer(tag, VERSION) i den installerede binær igen en ny version, og det giver en opdateringsløkke.
fix: Grep efter "const VERSION = '$VERSION'" i begge binærer og stop ved fejl. Tjek `git status --porcelain` og at HEAD er pushet. Overvej --draft, efterfulgt af publicering.
evidence: scripts/release.sh hele filen læst: ingen versions-, git status- eller draft-tjek. Uploaden bruger --target $(git rev-parse HEAD), og den commit er måske ikke pushet. lol-helper.js:973-978 (newer) og 996 bekræfter, at en binær med lavere VERSION end tagget vil se tagget som nyt igen. Brugen ('bash scripts/build.sh && bash scripts/release.sh', linje 4) gør scenariet mindre sandsynligt, men intet i scriptet forhindrer det.

title: Single-instance-tjekket rammer kun cfg.port og sker før den første kopi lytter, så to kopier kan køre samtidig
problem: Tjekket er et fetch til cfg.port/state (2246-2259). Den kørende kopi lytter først efter loadStaticData() (2264-2266), og listenWithFallback falder tilbage til port+1..+10 (2050-2054). Der findes ingen app-lockfil.
fix: Lockfil med pid og port i APP_DIR før loadStaticData, eller lyt tidligt og svar 'starter...'. Lad --updated overtage lockfilen.
evidence: lol-helper.js:2246-2259, 2263-2266 og 2045-2063 læst. grep 'lock' rammer kun League's lockfile (93-131), ikke en app-lås. Hvor sandsynligt et dobbeltklik er inden for den tid, Data Dragon-hentningen tager, er ikke målt. Port-fallback-scenariet (3399 optaget af et andet program) følger direkte af koden.

title: Voice callouts overlap: every speak() starts its own PowerShell synthesizer with no queue
problem: The debounce is per kind only. Each accepted call runs its own powershell.exe with Add-Type System.Speech and a blocking Speak(), and nothing serializes these processes. One announce() tick can emit 'start', 'afford', 'skill', 'core' and 'fed', and trackOpponent can add 'opp-item' in the same updateLive. These run in parallel processes and talk over each other.
fix: Use one long-lived PowerShell child that reads lines from stdin and speaks them in order (or a JS-side queue that runs one process at a time). Add a small global queue with newest-wins per kind, and respawn the child if it exits.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1462-1479: lastSpoken is keyed by kind, and each call is an independent execFile('powershell.exe', ... $s.Speak(...)) with an empty callback (no waiting or queueing). lol-helper.js:1482-1508: announce() can call speak() with 'start', 'afford', 'skill', 'core' and 'fed' in one call. lol-helper.js:1546-1547: trackOpponent runs right before announce in the same tick. The overlap is verified in code. The cold-start latency and CPU cost of PowerShell plus Add-Type on the user's PC is not measured (no Windows machine). Severity lowered to medium: the overlap is real, but how often several kinds fire within about 2 s of each other is not proven. Level-up plus afford in base is a likely pair.

title: Debounce silently drops callouts for good, and a diff against only the last tick re-announces items that flicker
problem: When speak() drops a message because the same kind spoke in the last 8 s, announce() still saves the new afford/fed state in app.voice, so the message is never retried. 'afford' also announces only newAfford[0] and marks the others as said. The diff is only against the previous tick, so a fed enemy who drops out of the relative criterion and comes back is announced again. The same happens to an advice item that leaves the top-N list and returns.
fix: Keep per-game Sets of announced fed names and afford ids, cleared at game end. When the debounce blocks a message, keep it pending (or merge the names) and do not record it as announced.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1465: early return with no queue. lol-helper.js:1507: `app.voice = { afford, fed, ... }` runs regardless of whether speak() actually spoke. lol-helper.js:1498: only newAfford[0] is spoken. lol-helper.js:1241-1242: the fed filter has a relative branch, `t >= avgThreat * 1.4 && p.kills >= 3`, that can toggle as other enemies' threat changes. The absolute branch, `kills-deaths>=3 && kills>=4`, can also flip back when the enemy dies. The scenario is consistent with the code.

title: Reconnect after a crash ends the game after about 6 s: history gets split, the plan is wiped and the start callout can repeat
problem: Two consecutive ECONNREFUSED/404 results set gone>=2. With a 3 s wait while the client is up, that is about 6 s. finishGame() then saves a partial record if gameTime >= 300 (result null), and clearPick() wipes app.plan, app.build and the jungle data. On reconnect, trackGame builds a fresh app.game with lastItems set to the current items, so the match is split into two records. starterAnnounced is reset, so the start callout repeats if the reconnect happens before any purchase in the first 3 min.
fix: Add a grace period, or finish only when the LCU gameflow phase leaves InProgress/Reconnect (or GameEnd was seen). Keep app.game, app.plan and app.voice when play resumes with the same champion.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1551-1573: the gone counter, wait=3000 when app.client is set, and the reset of voice/starterAnnounced followed by finishGame(). lol-helper.js:936-939: finishGame sets app.game=null and calls clearPick(). lol-helper.js:926-934: clearPick nulls plan, planKey and build. lol-helper.js:940: games under 300 s are skipped, so a crash after 5 min is recorded. lol-helper.js:904-905: trackGame creates a new game object. lol-helper.js:2199 shows the gameflow phase is already polled, so a phase-based end is feasible. The code path is verified. It is plausible rather than confirmed because it depends on real-client behaviour: I assume port 2999 closes on a bugsplat or disconnect, which is likely since the game process serves it, but I did not test it.

title: System.Speech default voice is probably English: Danish sentences read by an English voice (uncertain)
problem: The PowerShell command uses the System.Speech default voice and never selects a voice or culture, but every phrase is in Danish ('Råd til', 'færdig', 'er fed', 'har købt'), mixed with English item and champion names. If no Danish SAPI5 voice is installed, an English voice reads the Danish words.
fix: Log GetInstalledVoices() on the first run. Choose a voice explicitly (SelectVoiceByHints with da-DK), or fall back to English phrases. Optionally add a voiceLang config option or use WinRT SpeechSynthesis to reach OneCore voices.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1472-1474: the command is 'Add-Type ...; $s = New-Object ...SpeechSynthesizer; $s.Rate = 1; $s.Speak(...)' with no SelectVoice call. The phrases at lol-helper.js:1492-1505 and :519 are Danish. I could not verify which voices the user's Windows PC exposes to SAPI5. That Microsoft Helle (da-DK) is OneCore-only is my understanding, not something I checked, so this stays plausible.

title: Doran's Bow and Doran's Helm missing from the sellable starters
problem: SELLABLE_STARTERS only has 1054/1055/1056/1082/1083. Doran's Bow (1086) and Doran's Helm (1120) are missing. With 6 occupied slots, every new item with no owned parts is skipped at line 1420 (if (!sellable.length) continue). The player gets no 'sælg Doran's Bow' suggestion. Only items that reuse owned components still show up.
fix: Add '1086' and '1120'. Optionally derive the set from DDragon: 'Lane'-tagged items with no from/into and low gold, plus Dark Seal and Cull.
evidence: DDragon 16.21.1: 1086 Doran's Bow (400 g, tags include Lane) and 1120 Doran's Helm (450 g) exist. OP.GG global ranked Tryndamere top (fetched today): the top starter is Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion at 47.5% (the reviewer's 68.7% probably comes from a different region or tier; the order of magnitude matches). The code path is lines 1344-1346 and 1418-1424. I did not rerun the full 6-slot scenario, but the filter logic is clear.

title: Build-order logic breaks for Evelynn because OP.GG combos start with Dark Seal and have 4 items
problem: nextInBuild compares the first k combo ids against ownedNonBoots, which only holds completed items (line 1352). Dark Seal is never completed (it has into [3041] and costs 350 g), so every combo that starts with Dark Seal fails ids.slice(0,k).every(owned.has) once k >= 1. At k=0, Dark Seal takes share from the real 1st item. That share is wasted, because liveAdvice filters Dark Seal out with isCompleted. The hard 'k >= 3 return null' also drops the 4th item in 4-item combos.
fix: Before matching, filter each combo's ids to isCompleted, non-boots items. Return null only when no combo has more than k items.
evidence: OP.GG global ranked Evelynn jungle (fetched today): 6 of the 8 top core_items are 4-item combos that start with Dark Seal (for example Dark Seal + Lich Bane + Mejai's + Rabadon's, the top row, 9.7%). Only 3 combos start directly with Lich Bane. DDragon: 1082 Dark Seal, 350 g, into [3041], so isCompleted is false at lol-helper.js:1065-1066. nextInBuild is at lines 1294-1307. The exact game counts the reviewer cites (1527 etc.) come from a different data slice. The structure is confirmed.

title: Reconnect after a game crash ends the game: duplicate history entry and buys lost
problem: liveLoop calls finishGame() after 2 consecutive ECONNREFUSED/404 results on port 2999 and never checks the LCU gameflow phase. finishGame saves history when gameTime >= 300 and calls clearPick(). After a reconnect, trackGame builds a fresh app.game whose lastItems is the current inventory, so the earlier buys are gone and the real game end writes a second entry.
fix: Before finishGame, check /lol-gameflow/v1/gameflow-phase when app.client exists. In Reconnect/InProgress/GameStart, keep app.game, app.build and app.plan. Alternatively, key app.game on the gameId.
evidence: Code path verified. The gone counter (1553) is reset only on success (1550). The finish block (1564-1571) has no phase check. finishGame (936-965) sets app.game=null, calls clearPick() (926-934, which wipes build/plan/jungle) and saves when gameTime >= 300 (940). trackGame (904-905) re-creates app.game with lastItems = the current itemIds, so items owned before the crash are never counted as buys. One mitigating detail: app.liveBuild is also reset, so the build is refetched from OP.GG (not from champ select, because app.build is null), and the plan is refetched. Not verified: whether port 2999 really closes or returns 404 for at least 6 s during a reconnect. That needs a real client, so the verdict is plausible.

title: An OP.GG failure is never retried: no live advice for the whole game, no runes in champ select
problem: In live play, a getBuild failure stores {championKey, build:null}, and the build is never fetched again because the championKey matches. In champ select, app.applied is set before getBuild, so a failure is never retried. When app.build is null the GUI shows no champion view at all, so the role-button retry that the code comment relies on cannot be reached in any mode, not only ARAM. cachedJson ignores a disk cache older than 6 h even when the network fails.
fix: Use a retryAt for build:null in updateLive. In handlePick, set app.applied (or a retry flag) only after getBuild succeeds. In cachedJson, fall back to a stale file (< 24 h) when the loader throws.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1518-1527: the guard `app.liveBuild?.championKey !== champ.key` is false after a failed fetch, so there is no refetch. liveAdvice returns [] when !build (1325), and starterAdvice returns null when !build (1279). handlePick sets app.applied (2111) before `await getBuild` (2119). In tick (2221), a later enemy-lock change only alters itemKey, so fullApply=false and `if (!app.build) return` (2121) applies. viewModel returns base without champion when !b (1770), and gui.html:555-556 then renders the overview, so the role buttons (gui.html:573-575) never render after a failure. The comment at 2110 ('rolle-knappen i vinduet prøver igen') is therefore unreachable. cachedJson:279 only uses the file if it is younger than CACHE_TTL (6 h), while pruneCache keeps files for 24 h (267). Minor correction: the timeout is 15 s (getJson:188), not 20 s.

title: Arena (CHERRY) in-game: Summoner's Rift starter items announced, Control Ward and boots tips shown
problem: updateLive special-cases only ARAM. In Arena, handlePick returns before setting app.build (2105-2107), so updateLive fetches a ranked SR build. liveAdvice filters items by maps[30] and ends up empty. starterAdvice, wardTip and bootsTip do not check maps, so SR starters are shown and spoken, and the ward and boots tips appear.
fix: In updateLive, skip build, advice, starter and voice for gameMode CHERRY or mapNumber 30. Also add maps[mapNumber] !== false checks to starterAdvice, wardTip and bootsTip.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1522 checks only `gameMode === 'ARAM'`. handlePick:2105-2107 returns for CHERRY without app.build, so 1520 falls through to getBuild ranked. starterAdvice (1277-1289) has no maps check, and announce speaks it once (1490-1494). wardTip (1149-1150) and bootsTip (1144-1146) have no maps check, unlike elixirOk (1153) and liveAdvice (1372). Data Dragon 16.21.1 (fetched): 2055, 1054, 1055, 2003, 3071, 3047 and 3006 all have maps['30']=false. The README:22 'Arena springes over' only covers champ select. Not verified: the exact Live Client gameData.gameMode string ('CHERRY') and whether the inventory is empty at round 1. mapNumber 30 is a more robust key.

title: Program dies at startup if Data Dragon is unreachable (e.g. Windows autostart before the network is ready)
problem: main() does `await loadStaticData()` with no try or retry. getJson (lines 187-191) throws on a non-OK response or a 15 s timeout, and the window server is not started yet. main().catch at the end of the file logs the error and exits (after 30 s in the SEA build). DDragon is not cached on disk anywhere.
fix: Retry with backoff and show a status message while waiting. Optionally cache the DDragon JSON files in CACHE_DIR as an offline fallback.
evidence: lol-helper.js:2261 sits directly in main with no try. getJson:187-191 has no retry. The bottom of the file has main().catch -> process.exit(1) / setTimeout exit 30 s under IS_SEA. --autostart sets openWindow=false (line 2242), so no UI shows the error. Not verified: whether Windows logon autostart actually runs before the network is up on the user's PC. The code path itself is certain.

title: Dark Seal is never suggested in-game, so the first back for ~2/3 of Evelynns gets the wrong advice
problem: liveAdvice skips non-completed items (1372). starterAdvice returns null after the first purchase or after 180 s (1280). The one indirect path is affordablePart(Mejai's), which would return Dark Seal (1164-1179), but Mejai's does not make the top 3 on a first back, so Dark Seal is not shown in practice.
fix: When no completed non-boots item is owned and the leading early component of the core combos (e.g. 1082) is not owned, add it as a fact/option line, e.g. 'Dark Seal - 350 g, X% starter core med den'. The fix for the first finding provides the data for this. Phrase it as an option.
evidence: I computed liveAdvice pop on the 16.20 data: 3100 0.92, 3089 0.65, 4645 0.48, 1082 0.45, 3041 0.28. On a first back with about 600 g: Lich is added as nextUp (1449-1450), then the rest are added by score (Shadowflame ~65, Rabadon ~48, Mejai's ~28), and maxOut is 3 (1434). So Mejai's, and with it the Dark Seal 'part', is cut. Research doc line 28 says 'recall for Dark Seal'. Downgraded to medium: it is a missing suggestion, not wrong advice that is shown.

title: The jungle pet takes up a slot, so a jungler with 5 items gets no suggestions at all (no swap, no elixir)
problem: slotsUsed (1105) counts the pet, which sits in a slot below 6. With pet + 5 completed items: freeSlots = 0 (1339), full = false (1338, needs 6 completed). The pet is not in SELLABLE_STARTERS (1134), so sellable is empty. Every new item without owned parts then hits `continue` (1421), swapOut is null, and the elixir needs full (1153). Result: an empty buy list and no elixir.
fix: When freeSlots === 0 and nothing is sellable, treat it like full: run the swap logic and the elixir offer. Whether the pet can be sold in the live client, and for how much, is unverified: DDragon 1101-1103 says sell 0, and 1105-1107 says sell 180.
evidence: Checked lines 1105, 1134, 1338-1346, 1351-1353, 1416-1422 and 1153. DDragon 16.21.1: 1101/1102/1103 have 450 g, tags ['Jungle'], sell 0, no into, so they are not completed. That pets stay in the real Live Client items list late game is very likely but not tested against a real client.

title: Enemy item callouts are spoken by default, and the docs still promise level 6 / 'who has ult' for the opponent
problem: voiceEnemy is true by default (36), and its comment still says 'eller når level 6'. trackOpponent speaks '<opp> har købt <item>' (516, 523). The code deliberately removed level-6/ult (525, 538), but LAES-MIG.txt:12-15 and README.md:79-80 still promise 'hvem der har ult' and level-6 voice. The research doc (table line 38 and section 4 item 5) recommends opt-in for enemy-item callouts.
fix: Set voiceEnemy to false by default (opt-in in the GUI) and keep the text log. Fix the comment on line 36, LAES-MIG.txt lines 12-15 and README.md lines 79-80.
evidence: Read lol-helper.js lines 36, 514-527 and 537-538. LAES-MIG.txt lines 12-16: 'level (og hvem der har ult)' and 'når level 6 ... stemmen siger det'. README.md lines 79-80: 'Live: level og hvem der har ult' and 'Ændringer: hans nye færdige items og level 6 ... siges højt'. README line 74 says the opposite ('Ingen notifikationer om modstanderens level 6'). The docs mismatch is certain. Whether enemy-item voice is forbidden is a gray zone, not proven.

title: Item settets smart-core passer ikke med den core, som gameplanen og stemmen bruger
problem: recommend() vælger core via rankOptions(build.core_items, cfg). Standarden er buildChoice 'smart' (28, config.json). coreOf (433), som bruges til plan.myCore (478) og stemmens 'n af 3 i dit core build' (1486-1502), tager derimod altid core_items[0], altså den mest populære. rankOptions' tærskel er 25% af den mest spillede kombination (588-596). Når den mest spillede core selv kun dækker ca. 10% af kampene, slipper en niche-kombi med få procent igennem.
fix: Gem den core, recommend() valgte, i app.rec, og brug den i plan.myCore og announce(). Alternativt: vis den populære core i item settet og nævn højere-WR-varianten som en note.
evidence: Læst 28, 433, 478, 588-596, 684-688, 1486-1502. På OP.GG 16.21 (kun 280 kampe) er topkombien 20 kampe, så min=100 og smart falder tilbage til popular. Afvigelsen viser sig derfor kun med data fra en tyk patch (eller 16.20 via thin-patch-fallback). Uoverensstemmelsen i koden er bekræftet. Tallet 'Yun Tal/LDR/EH 59,3%' har jeg ikke genberegnet.

title: Gameplanens forslag ignorerer unikke passiver (Profane Hydra foreslås ved siden af Ravenous Hydra)
problem: planNow.options filtrerer kun på ejet/isCompleted/pred. Det ownedPassives-tjek, liveAdvice har (1341, 1375), mangler. DDragon: Ravenous, Titanic og Profane Hydra har alle passiven 'Cleave', og Profane har tagget ArmorPenetration.
fix: Lav en fælles helper, der udelukker items med samme <passive> som et ejet færdigt item, og brug den både i planNow.options og i liveAdvice.
evidence: Læst 482-485 (myPool = core-ids + last_items >=2%) og 549-554. OP.GG 16.21: Profane Hydra findes i core-kombi #10 og i last_items med 11,84%, så den er i myPool. ArmorPen-items i myPool-rækkefølge: LDR, Mortal Reminder, Profane Hydra. Ejer man Hydra+LDR med opp.armor>=40, giver det 'Mortal Reminder, Profane Hydra'. Bekræftet ved at følge koden mod de rigtige data.

title: Matchup-items med lav generel popularitet bliver filtreret væk før matchup-boostet
problem: pop bygges kun fra det generelle build (1326-1329), og 2%-filteret (1380) kører før vsBoost (1398). matchupItemBoost (1310-1320) kræver, at itemet findes i de generelle last_items, men ikke at det ligger over 2%. Items med et stort boost, men under 2% generelt, kan derfor aldrig dukke op.
fix: Undtag items med en vsBoost-indgang fra 2%-filteret, eller brug max(general, vs) som popularitet.
evidence: Læst 1310-1320, 1326-1329, 1354, 1378-1380, 1398. OP.GG 16.21 TOP: Wit's End har 1,25%, Mercurial 1,87% og Titanic Hydra 0,62% i de generelle last_items, alle under 2%. Mekanismen er bekræftet. Teemo-tallene (6,8%, >=100 kampe) kan ikke genskabes på 16.21: mod Teemo er der kun 3 kampe, så x.play<100, og boostet ville alligevel ikke slå til. Eksemplet bygger på 16.20-data, som jeg ikke har kontrolleret.

title: Champion select bruger ikke matchup-core, og matchup-startitems vælges efter popularitet
problem: recommend() bruger kun matchup.build til start (678-681) og runer (719). Core, støvler, counter og situationelle items kommer fra det generelle build (684-709). mStart er starter_items[0], dvs. OP.GG's popularitetsrækkefølge, og der bruges aldrig rankOptions(cfg). Det gælder også i starterAdvice (1280-1282).
fix: Når matchup.build har nok kampe, så vis en blok 'Core mod <navn>' fra rankOptions(matchup.build.core_items, cfg). Brug rankOptions(matchup.build.starter_items, cfg) til start.
evidence: Læst 676-688 og 1276-1283. Det er en forbedring, ikke en fejl, og koden gør det, den er skrevet til. Malphite-tallene (LDR-cores, Doran's Shield 45,6% mod Bow 41,6%) har jeg ikke verificeret, fordi jeg ikke har hentet Malphite-data. Ved store WR-forskelle på få hundrede kampe er der også risiko for, at man jagter støj.

title: Svage andels-grunde (+15 AP/AD-andel) giver garanteret plads og fortrænger buildets faste items
problem: adapted (1396) er true for enhver ikke-'i gang'-grund, også den svage +15 for adShare>=0.65 eller apShare>=0.55 (1393-1394). Linje 1453 giver op til 2 adapted items plads før rest.forEach. Med maxOut=3 og nextUp optaget er der ingen plads til populære støvler (fx Berserker's), før bootsTip slår til ved 10 min (1144).
fix: Lad kun de stærke grunde give 'adapted' (fed modstander, armorHeavy/mrHeavy, anti-heal mod rigtige healere, matchup-boost). Andels-grundene skal kun give score.
evidence: Læst 1386-1396, 1432-1456 og 1141-1146. Mekanismen er bekræftet. apShare=1-adShare er trusselsvægtet (1244-1246), så et hold med en eller to AP-champions kan let nå 0,55. 'Malphite alene' er et kunstigt scenarie (i en rigtig kamp er der 5 modstandere). Mercury's/Mercurial kommer med, fordi de findes i puljen: Mercurial ligger på 1,87% på 16.21 og ville nu blive filtreret fra ved 2%, så det konkrete eksempel afhænger af patchen.

title: Voice and swap texts are imperative and the voice gives only one option
problem: The voice speaks only the top new affordable suggestion ('Råd til X') and 'Level op: Q'. Swap/sell reasons are phrased as commands ('byt X ud', 'sælg X'). In fullscreen the voice is the only channel, so the user hears a single choice.
fix: Rephrase as options, e.g. 'Råd til et af dine forslag: X (+N andre)', 'Buildets næste evne: Q', 'Mulighed: byt X ud'.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1498 `speak('afford', `Råd til ${itemName(newAfford[0])}`)`, :1499 `Level op: ${L.skill.next}`, :1417 'Fullt build: byt ... ud', :1423 'Kræver en ledig plads: sælg ...'. The code is verified. This is weaker than it sounds: 'Råd til X' states an own-gold fact, the skill order is the player's own build data (common in approved tools), and the window lists 2-3 options. Whether Riot would treat this wording as 'dictating' is not verifiable here, so the finding is a wording polish.

title: 'Lige nu' and the scoreboard show derived item-gold sums and differences
problem: planNow shows 'Items: dig X g, <opp> Y g (+/-Z til dig)', and the scoreboard team header shows the summed item gold per team plus the difference. These are computed from list prices of the items visible on TAB, a number the client does not display directly.
fix: Optionally make the gold lines opt-in, or show item icons instead. Keep KDA and level.
evidence: lol-helper.js:540-541 build the Items line. lol-helper.js:1628 `itemGold: players.reduce(...)` per team. gui.html teamBlock shows `item-guld ${gold(t.itemGold)}` with diff. Uncertain: the inputs are all visible on TAB (enemy items), so this is derived from known info, not hidden info. Whether Riot treats derived sums as 'unknown information' is unverified, so the risk is low.

title: Selvopdatering kører den nye exe uden hash-tjek, selvom GitHub leverer digest
problem: checkUpdate (lol-helper.js:995-998) gemmer kun browser_download_url. applyUpdate (1012-1015) tjekker kun res.ok og buf.length >= 10 MB, før filen skrives som exe og startes (1017-1032). Der er intet tjek af hash, størrelse eller MZ-header.
fix: Gem asset.digest og asset.size i app.update. Afbryd i applyUpdate, hvis sha256(buf) eller buf.length ikke matcher. Bonus: tjek 'MZ' på win32. Det giver integritet, ikke ægthed. Ægthed kræver Authenticode-signering.
evidence: Læst 988-1048. Jeg har selv kaldt GitHub API'et. Release v1.12.0 har LoL-Rune-Helper.exe på 87271936 bytes med digest sha256:18acac5b61a50e97..., så fixet kræver ingen ændring i release.sh. scripts/build.sh:41 kører strip-authenticode.js. Derfor nedgraderet til low: download sker over HTTPS fra GitHub, og undici afviser normalt en body der er kortere end Content-Length, så en afbrudt download fejler i forvejen. En proxy der omskriver filen kræver TLS-MITM. Hvis selve release-asset'et bliver kompromitteret, matcher en digest fra samme API også, så hashen hjælper ikke mod det. Reel gevinst: billig beskyttelse mod korrupte bytes, fx en AV-proxy med egen CA. Det er ikke et alvorligt sikkerhedshul.

title: Dobbeltklik på 'Opdater nu' kan starte to samtidige opdateringer
problem: /api/update (2011-2019) har ingen lås. Knappen deaktiveres kun i det DOM-element, der blev klikket på (gui.html:235). log('Henter version...') (1011) kalder broadcast() (log, linje 56-61), og es.onmessage kalder render, som laver $app.replaceChildren() og updateBanner (gui.html:548-552, 697-703). Dermed bygges en ny, aktiv 'Opdater nu'-knap, mens filen hentes.
fix: Modul-flag/promise i applyUpdate: returnér med det samme, hvis en opdatering allerede kører. Eksponér update.inProgress i viewModel, så knappen bliver ved med at være deaktiveret.
evidence: Kæden er bekræftet i koden: log -> broadcast -> SSE -> render -> ny knap uden disabled. To kald vil begge køre writeFileSync(exe.new), rmSync(.old) og renameSync. Det præcise udfald af racen (hvilket rename der fejler, og om der spawnes to gange) afhænger af timing og er ikke testet. Da det andet kald ofte fejler på rename og den nye fil allerede ligger på plads, er udfaldet sandsynligvis begrænset, men det er ubestemt.

title: Host-allowlisten låses ved opstart (ny IP, Tailscale startet senere, MagicDNS giver 403)
problem: remoteUrls og setAllowedHosts bliver kun kaldt én gang i main (ca. linje 2265-2271). handleRequest (1944-1947) afviser enhver anden Host med 403 'Ukendt adresse'. Hostnavne (MagicDNS, os.hostname()) tillades aldrig.
fix: Genberegn urls og allowedHosts periodisk, eller når Host ikke matcher, og tillad konfigurerbare hostnavne.
evidence: Kaldene i main er bekræftet. Ingen setInterval eller anden genberegning er fundet (grep setAllowedHosts giver kun definitionen og ét kald). Om Tailscale-interfacet faktisk mangler ved autostart-tidspunktet på brugerens PC, er ikke verificeret, men en ny DHCP-IP giver med sikkerhed 403.

title: QR-bibliotek fra cdnjs uden SRI på loopback-siden
problem: loadQr (gui.html:511-521) indsætter et script fra cdnjs uden integrity eller crossorigin. Scriptet kører i 127.0.0.1-originen og kan kalde loopback-only-endpoints og læse /state, hvor remote.urls indeholder token'et (lol-helper.js:1754).
fix: sc.integrity = 'sha384-3zSEDfvllQohrq0PHL1fOXJuC/jSOO34H46t6UQfobFOmxE5BpjjaIJY5F2/bMnU'; sc.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'. Alternativt: bundl biblioteket lokalt.
evidence: Jeg har selv hentet https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js og beregnet sha384. Den matcher præcis den foreslåede hash. Indlæses kun, når remote er slået til og man er på loopback (phoneCard, gui.html:524-525). Kræver at cdnjs bliver kompromitteret, eller at nogen bryder HTTPS, så risikoen er lav, men fixet er en linje.

title: A stale lockfile in a fixed C:/D:/E: path can keep the PowerShell fallback from running
problem: On win32, findClient returns the first readable lockfile from the fixed paths before it tries PowerShell, and never checks whether that client is alive. After ECONNREFUSED the main loop sets app.client=null (2286-2287), and the next tick reads the same stale file again, so PowerShell is never reached while that file exists.
fix: After a connection error on lockfile credentials, skip that file until its mtime changes, or check the PID in field 2 with process.kill(pid, 0), then fall through to PowerShell.
evidence: lol-helper.js:93-103 (fixed candidate paths), 113-116 (lockfile tried first with no liveness check), 135-142 (readLockfile only validates the format), 2182-2186 (tick calls findClient when client is null), 2286-2287. I lowered severity to low: when League restarts from the same install folder it rewrites the lockfile, which fixes this by itself. The only lasting failure is a stale file in C/D/E:\Riot Games while the real install lives somewhere else. With no client running, PowerShell would find nothing anyway. Whether Riot leaves a lockfile behind after a crash is not verified.

title: Overlay (Document PiP) needs Chrome/Edge, but the window opens in the default browser
