problem: openBrowser uses `cmd /c start "" url`, which opens the default browser. gui.html only shows an alert when documentPictureInPicture is missing. This is a UX improvement, not a bug. Whether it matters depends on Tobias' default browser.
fix: On win32, try `cmd /c start "" msedge --app=<url>` first and fall back to the default browser, or add a config option. Keep the alert as a fallback.
evidence: lol-helper.js:2066-2069 (openBrowser), gui.html:607-611 (alert when PiP is missing). Tobias' default browser is unknown.

title: (Uncertain) No warning when the exe runs from inside the zip or a temp folder
problem: APP_DIR = dirname(process.execPath) for SEA builds. If Explorer runs the exe straight from the zip, it is extracted alone under %TEMP%. config.json is then missing (ENOENT gives defaults silently, 67), and the autostart .lnk (1841-1842) and the update rename would point into the temp folder.
fix: On win32, detect APP_DIR under os.tmpdir() or a path containing 'Temp1_', show a banner telling the user to unpack the zip first, and refuse to enable autostart or self-update from there.
evidence: lol-helper.js:22 (APP_DIR), 24 (CONFIG_PATH), 67 (ENOENT is not logged), 1841-1842 (shortcut TargetPath/WorkingDirectory). Explorer normally warns first, offering 'Extract all' or 'Run' for files inside a zip. What it extracts was not verified on Windows.

title: Jungle route card shows both sides and ignores OP.GG's start-camp rate
problem: jungleCard (gui.html:270-281) always renders BLUE and RED side by side. viewModel (lol-helper.js:1763) passes both. parseJungleRoutes (lol-helper.js:382-399) only reads routes and drops the `rate` object.
fix: Pass the side (live L.me.team ORDER/CHAOS; the champ-select team field is unverified) and show that side first or only. Parse `"rate":{"team_key":..,"blue":..,"red":..,"raptors":..}` and show the start-camp shares.
evidence: Fetched op.gg/lol/champions/evelynn/jungle-paths/jungle. The page contains "rate":{"team_key":"BLUE","blue":52,"red":17,"raptors":29} and a RED variant (38/20/36). The top route on both sides is the same, [BLUE,GROMP,WOLVES,RAPTORS,RED,KRUG] (16388 vs 12299 games), so the two columns largely duplicate each other. L.me.team is used at lol-helper.js:1631. Whether champ-select myTeam[].team works is not verified. This is UX only, not a bug.

title: Switching the role away from JUNGLE leaves the jungle route card visible
problem: `if (position !== 'JUNGLE' || ...) return;` never clears app.jungle. /api/role (line 1996-2002) only sets roleOverride and re-applies, so handlePick calls ensureJungleRoutes(.., 'TOP') (line 2129), which returns and leaves the stale routes. gui.html renders jungleCard(s.jungle) unconditionally in champ select (line 577), and in-game while gameTime < 300 (line 500).
fix: if (position !== 'JUNGLE') { app.jungle = null; app.jungleKey = null; return; }
evidence: Read lol-helper.js:414-424, 926-934 (only clearPick resets jungle), 1996-2002, 2129, 1535, and gui.html:500 and 577. Neither render site checks the position. The scenario needs a role change after the routes load (Auto -> JUNGLE, then a manual TOP click), which is uncommon, so the severity is low.

title: Live opponent detection has no Smite fallback when position is empty or champ select was missed
problem: analyzeLive finds the opponent by enemies.find(p => p.position === me.position), otherwise by app.plan.oppKey or app.rec.matchup (lines 1255-1259). If the program starts mid-game, app.plan and app.rec are null, and if the live position is also empty, opponent is null. livePlayer (line 1084-1110) does not read summonerSpells at all.
fix: Store hasSmite in livePlayer from summonerSpells. When there is no position match and I am a jungler (by position or Smite), use the single enemy with Smite. Optionally use it to infer JUNGLE for ensureJungleRoutes.
evidence: Read lol-helper.js:1052, 1084-1110 and 1254-1260. grep finds no 'summonerSpells' or 'Smite' anywhere in lol-helper.js. When the Live Client leaves position empty is unverified (ranked normally fills it), and starting the program mid-game is an edge case. The fallback only helps junglers (it does nothing for Tryndamere TOP), so the severity is low. The data is visible on TAB, so it is policy-safe.

title: Gameplan card labels OP.GG's jungle 'lane advantage' as 'Lane' for a jungler
problem: fetchMatchupGuide maps JUNGLE to 'jungle' (lol-helper.js:330) and stores lane_advantage_champion as laneAdvantage (line 354). gameplanCard always labels the chip 'Lane' (gui.html:294, not 291 as cited). The card header comment and the copy at gui.html:394 are lane-based too.
fix: Pass plan.position to the view and use a jungle label (for example 'Tidligt i kampen') when it is JUNGLE. Wording only.
evidence: Read lol-helper.js:330-358, 473 and 1691, and gui.html:285-296. The line is off by 3. I did not re-run the MCP call, but the label logic is position-independent no matter what the MCP returns. Cosmetic.

title: Overlayets 'mangler X' ignorerer salg/bytte-værdien og modsiger hovedvinduet
problem: Overlayet viser cost - L.gold. Hovedvinduet viser cost - gold - extra (gui.html:439, 443). Serverens canAfford bygger på budget = gold + værdien af salg/bytte (lol-helper.js:1409-1427).
fix: Send missing = max(0, cost - budget) fra serveren, og brug det begge steder.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1414 og 1421 lægger salgsværdien til budget, og 1427 sætter canAfford: cost <= budget. Uoverensstemmelsen opstår kun, når canAfford er false og sell/swap er sat (fuldt build eller ingen ledig plads). Reviewerens eksempel 'mangler 0 g' kan ikke ske, fordi canAfford så ville være true. Forskellen er salgsværdien, og den er typisk et par hundrede til et par tusinde guld.

title: Champ select uden draft-data viser startskærmen uden tegn på, at noget hentes eller er fejlet
problem: render viser kun renderDraft, når s.draft findes (gui.html:555). Indtil analyzeDraft er færdig, når den fejler (lol-helper.js:885, kun log), eller når rollen ikke er en fast position (867), vises startskærmen med teksten, der lover ban-forslag. Når kaldet fejler, prøves der heller ikke igen, før key ændrer sig, fordi draftKey allerede er sat (878).
fix: Send draftStatus (loading/error/unsupported) med i viewModel, og vis et lille champ select-kort i stedet for startskærmen.
evidence: Delvist afhjulpet: statusLine (gui.html:211-213, 558) viser allerede 'Champion select - venter på at du låser en champion.' (lol-helper.js:2207), så brugeren kan se, at han er i champ select. Det, der mangler, er en angivelse af hentning eller fejl. Severity er sat ned til low.

title: Rækkefølgen i kamp: statisk gameplan og et kopi-scoreboard står over det, der er nyt
problem: I renderLive kommer gameplanCard (med chips, tip og core builds) før scoreboardet, og 'Lige nu' ligger inde i gameplanen. Prioriteringen er en designvurdering. At scoreboardet spejler TAB, er bevidst og passer med policy-princippet om 'kun data fra TAB'.
fix: Overvej at folde den faste del af gameplanen sammen i kamp. At genskabe åbne details efter render er relevant først, når der kommer flere details.
evidence: gui.html:495-508 og 284-305 er tjekket. Påstanden om, at genskabelsen af details 'kun virker for det første element', er ikke en aktuel fejl: der findes kun ét <details> (gui.html:223, grep). Det er korrekt, at Bip-knappen (619) og pagehide (618) kalder render uden at genskabe åben-tilstanden, så loggen klapper sammen. Brudpunkterne i CSS er 760/640 px (gui.html:34, 113), ikke 1000 px. Det er subjektiv UX og ikke bevist.

title: Lane advantage, solo kills and play style from OP.GG MCP come from the newest patch's tiny sample, with no sample size shown
problem: fetchMatchupGuide uses lane_advantage_champion, lane_solo_kill_advantage_champion and recommended_play_style without any game count, and the GUI shows them as plain chips (gui.html:294-296). The payload's matchup data is tiny. What I could not verify is whether OP.GG computes those three verdict fields from that same small sample or from a larger aggregate.
fix: Return a games count from the payload (e.g. sum of data.summoner_spells[].play) and show it next to the chips, or mark them as 'få kampe' below MATCHUP_MIN_GAMES. Do not assume the MCP accepts a version argument without checking tools/list.
evidence: One live MCP call today (TRYNDAMERE vs DARIUS, top): summary.average_stats.play=280, summoner_spells play 12+1=13. It returned EVEN / Darius / even, which matches the reviewer's report. The code at lol-helper.js:349-355 passes the fields through unchanged. Marked plausible because OP.GG's derivation of the verdict fields is undocumented.

title: In-game opponent detection depends only on the live position field; no Smite fallback for the enemy jungler
problem: analyzeLive matches the opponent only by p.position === me.position, then falls back to the champ-select knownOpp. livePlayer (1084-1108) does not read summonerSpells, so Smite cannot serve as a fallback. If position is empty and no champ-select guess exists (for example, the app was started mid-game), there is no opponent, no ensurePlan at 1534, and no gameplan.
fix: Read summonerSpells in livePlayer into a hasSmite flag, and for a JUNGLE/Smite player prefer the enemy with Smite before the knownOpp fallback.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1255-1259 (opponent selection), 1084-1108 (no summonerSpells), 1532-1534 (ensurePlan only when opp found). The test fixture sets summonerSpells: {} (test/fake-lcu.test.js:125). I could not verify whether the real Live Client Data API leaves position empty in blind or normal queues without a real client.

title: laneOpponent picks each role on its own and ignores the rest of the enemy team
problem: laneOpponent takes the enemy with the highest role_rate for your position (threshold 0.25, lines 362-374). It does not consider which roles the other enemies must fill. OP.GG summary.positions lists only main roles, so flex picks are invisible.
fix: Optionally choose the role assignment that maximizes the joint probability across the locked enemies, and label the result as a guess. The manual opponent override (/api/opponent) already covers mistakes, so this is an improvement, not a bug.
evidence: Code at lol-helper.js:362-374. Verified today that summary.positions holds only [[TOP,0.858]] for champion 23 (Tryndamere) and only [[JUNGLE,0.977]] for 28 (Evelynn). A manual override exists (findMatchup 2171 uses app.opponentOverride), which lowers the impact.

title: Matchup win rate is shown in large colored type even from about 30 games
problem: matchupStats returns win/play with no minimum sample, and gui.html:291 shows it as a colored 18px win rate. MATCHUP_MIN_GAMES (664) is not applied. The game count is shown below the header (gui.html:292, 'Din win rate i N kampe'), which partly offsets this.
fix: Grey out the win rate or add '(få kampe)' when games < MATCHUP_MIN_GAMES.
evidence: lol-helper.js:563-566. Today's OP.GG Evelynn JUNGLE counters end with entries of 33, 32, 32, 31 and 30 games (champion 79: 15/30). gui.html:291-292 render the colored win rate and the game count.

title: Evelynn's core list includes Dark Seal, so core progress and the voice line top out at 3 of 4
problem: coreOf passes core_items[0].ids through unchanged. For Evelynn JUNGLE this includes Dark Seal (1082), which isCompleted rejects. announce counts only completed core items but divides by coreList.length, so the voice line can say at most '3 af 4'. planNow (546-548) has no isCompleted filter, so it shows 'Dit core build: 1/4 (Dark Seal)' when only Dark Seal is owned.
fix: Filter coreOf's ids with isCompleted(dd.items[id]).
evidence: OP.GG today: Evelynn (28) JUNGLE core_items[0].ids = [1082,3100,3041,3089]. Data Dragon 16.21.1: 1082 Dark Seal 350g into [3041]. isCompleted at lol-helper.js:1065-1066 requires into.length===0 and gold>=1500. announce at 1486-1487 filters with isCompleted, and 1499 divides by coreList.length. planNow 546 'progress' has no isCompleted check.

title: previousPatch() vælger en NYERE patch når Data Dragon er foran OP.GG - spildt request
problem: previousPatch tager den første version i dd.versions, der er forskellig fra OP.GG's version (303), ikke den første ældre. Når OP.GG halter efter Data Dragon, bliver 'forrige' den nyere patch, og kaldet svarer 422. THIN_PATCH_GAMES=20000 (297) er en absolut grænse, så champions under 20k kampe altid laver det ekstra sekventielle kald (315-320) ved hver cache-miss.
fix: Vælg den første version, der numerisk er ÆLDRE end current. Lad fallback'en kun slå til, når OP.GG's version er den nyeste i Data Dragon, og brug en relativ eller lavere grænse for antal kampe.
evidence: Målt i dag: Data Dragon versions.json = ['16.21.1','16.20.1',...], og OP.GG euw/ranked/28/JUNGLE har meta.version=16.20 og play=16229. ?version=16.21 svarer HTTP 422. Ifølge kode 303 giver previousPatch('16.20') '16.21'. Fejlen fanges (321), og de tynde data bruges, så der er ingen forkerte runer. Gevinsten er kun mistet latency/trafik, og kun ved cache-miss (resultatet caches i 6 t), derfor nedjusteret til low. Desuden har 16.19 for Evelynn 16237 kampe (målt), så 3x-reglen (320) ville aldrig slå til for hende.

title: Draft og lane-modstander henter et fuldt build pr. champion bare for at læse role_rate
problem: myChampionPool laver en MID-probe (fuldt build) for op til 15 mastery- plus 8 historik-champions (802-815), og laneOpponent gør det samme for hver modstander (366). Begge bruger kun summary.positions[].stats.role_rate. Champions under 20k kampe udløser desuden thin-patch-kaldet (se previousPatch).
fix: Tilføj fetchRoleRates(region) via cachedJson mod /api/{region}/champions/ranked (ét kald, alle champions) og slå role_rate op i en Map i myChampionPool og laneOpponent.
evidence: Læst 798-862 og 362-374. Målt: GET lol-api-champion.op.gg/api/euw/champions/ranked giver 200 på 0,48 s og 188 KB, 173 champions, hver med positions[].stats.role_rate (fx id 23 TOP role_rate 0.857). Én probe er ca. 20 KB (målt 19906 bytes). Nedjusteret til low: probes caches i 6 t i hukommelse og på disk (273-293), så udbruddet kun rammer første draft pr. 6 t. MID-probes for laneOpponent deles med draft-analysen.

title: Fejlede OP.GG-kald caches ikke og prøves igen ved hver draft-ændring
problem: cachedJson sletter nøglen ved fejl (287-290), og updateDraft genkører analyzeDraft ved hver ny draftKey (875-879). limited() er ren FIFO (250-258), så brugerens getBuild kan stå bag draft-kald.
fix: Kort negativ cache (60-120 s) for fejlede nøgler og/eller prioritet i limited() for getBuild/findMatchup.
evidence: Koden er bekræftet (287-291, 250-258, 875-879). Det modvirker dog effekten: buildCache.set sker synkront ved oprettelsen (291), så mens et kald hænger, genbruger alle draft-ændringer det samme ventende promise og laver ikke nye kald. Der kommer først nye kald, når de gamle er fejlet, altså efter op til 15 s timeout (188). Hvis OP.GG svarer hurtigt med fejl (fx 429/5xx), tømmes køen hurtigt, men den gentagne trafik kan forværre rate-limiting. Hvis OP.GG hænger helt, fejler brugerens eget build typisk også, medmindre det er cachet. Den reelle effekt afhænger af OP.GG's faktiske fejladfærd og er ikke testet live.

title: limited() kan tillade 5 samtidige kald (race i slot-overdragelse)
problem: I finally sænkes activeRequests (256), og den ventende vækkes (257), men den tæller først op i en senere microtask. Et nyt limited()-kald, der ligger i microtask-køen før den vækkede, ser 3 og springer køen over.
fix: Overdrag pladsen direkte: i finally kald next() uden at sænke tælleren, hvis køen ikke er tom, ellers activeRequests--. Den vækkede tæller ikke op.
evidence: Node-snippet med samme limited()-kode (/tmp/lim5.js): når et nyt kald ligger i microtask-køen i præcis samme drain som fn-afslutningen (0 hop), bliver max samtidige 5. Med 1-7 hop er det 4. Vinduet er altså meget smalt. Det kan ske i praksis, når flere fetch-svar resolver i samme tick, men konsekvensen er højst ét ekstra samtidigt kald og en enkelt brudt FIFO. Ingen funktionel fejl, derfor low.

title: Hukommelses-TTL starter forfra når data læses fra disken - builds kan være op til ca. 12 timer gamle
problem: cachedJson sætter at: Date.now() (291), også når IIFE'en returnerer data fra en diskfil, der allerede kan være næsten 6 t gammel (279). Hukommelses-entry'en lever så 6 t mere, og nøglen indeholder ingen patch-version.
fix: Sæt at til filens mtimeMs, når data kommer fra disk (statSync kan ske synkront før promise oprettes). Overvej at invalidere cachen, når Data Dragon-versionen skifter.
evidence: Læst 273-293: 'at' bliver sat synkront ved oprettelsen, uafhængigt af om data kommer fra disk eller net. pruneCache (262-263) og hit-tjekket (275) bruger kun 'at'. Fil på 5t59m plus ny memory-TTL på 6t giver ca. 12 t. Det kræver en genstart (fx autostart eller opdatering) mens filerne er friske. Effekten er begrænset, fordi OP.GG selv halter efter en ny patch (målt i dag: OP.GG 16.20 mod Data Dragon 16.21), derfor low.

title: Ban suggestions can suggest banning a teammate's declared pick (championPickIntent)
problem: The unavailable list in updateDraft (869-872) uses completed bans and m.championId for both teams. Teammates' championPickIntent is ignored, although tick reads it for the local player (2210). analyzeDraft filters ban candidates only against unavailable (828), so a teammate's declared champion can appear under 'Ban-forslag' during the ban phase.
fix: Add (session.myTeam||[]).map(m => m.championPickIntent).filter(id => id > 0) to unavailable, at least for the bans filter. It is already part of the draft key, so a changed intent recalculates.
evidence: Checked lol-helper.js:864-880 and 822-838. A grep shows championPickIntent appears only at 2210. Severity lowered to low: the output is display-only text, and the real client warns before you ban a teammate's intent. Whether real LCU sessions expose teammates' championPickIntent during the ban phase is unverified (plausible from known LCU behaviour).

title: Only 'ARAM' and 'CHERRY' are special-cased; every other mode gets Summoner's Rift ranked runes and spells
problem: getBuild uses aram data only when gameMode === 'ARAM' (571), and handlePick skips only 'CHERRY' (2105). Every other mode (URF, ONEFORALL, ARAM variants with a different gameMode string) gets the SR ranked build with SR spells. If the gameflow session request fails, the code silently uses 'CLASSIC' (2224-2226).
fix: Use a whitelist (CLASSIC/SWIFTPLAY -> ranked, ARAM or mapId 12 -> aram, otherwise log and skip). On a gameflow error, retry next tick instead of assuming CLASSIC.
evidence: Confirmed in code at lol-helper.js:570-576, 2103-2108 and 2222-2226. Not verified: the real gameMode strings for rotating modes, e.g. whether ARAM: Mayhem reports something other than 'ARAM', and whether the client rejects a spell PATCH in those modes. Impact is therefore plausible, not confirmed.

title: The program has never seen a real LCU: log the raw data shapes on the first real champ select
problem: Champ-select logic depends on LCU fields that only fake tests have exercised: actions[][].actorCellId/type/completed/isInProgress, myTeam championPickIntent/assignedPosition/spell1Id, pages isDeletable/current, inventory.ownedPageCount, current-summoner.summonerId and the item-sets shape. A shape mismatch would fail silently, e.g. pickPending would be false or the draft would stay empty.
fix: Add an opt-in diagnostic dump of the first champ-select, gameflow, perks/pages, perks/inventory, currentpage and item-set responses to local files, then check the assumptions after the first real game.
evidence: One part of the claim is refuted: failed LCU writes already log the HTTP status and up to 300 chars of the body (localJson 172-174, surfaced via 'Fejl: ...' at 2290). So 'the log only says 400' is wrong for thrown errors. Silent wrong-shape cases remain real. The selectedPerkIds order assumption is used by autoPageUntouched (2161-2165) against perkKey (2079). If the client reorders the IDs, the result is false and the code only skips the matchup swap, which fails safe.

title: Lane opponent heuristic: the first enemy with role_rate >= 25% wins, without assigning roles across the whole enemy team
problem: laneOpponent picks the enemy with the highest role_rate for your position if it is >= 0.25 (365-377). It does not assign roles across the whole enemy team, so a flex pick can be named as the opponent while the real laner has not picked yet. The result drives matchup runes (auto-swapped at 2149-2151 when the page is untouched), start items, the gameplan and the draft counterpicks.
fix: Assign roles over all known enemies (permutations maximizing the sum of role_rate) and return null while it is ambiguous. Only swap runes automatically when the assignment is clear.
evidence: The code behaviour is confirmed at lol-helper.js:365-377 and 2145-2151. Mitigations: the manual opponent override (app.opponentOverride, used in findMatchup 2172), and the swap only happens on an untouched auto page. I did not fetch role_rate values for real flex champions, so how often this happens is unverified.

title: Den hentede programfil bliver ikke integritetstjekket - GitHub leverer allerede sha256-digest
problem: Det eneste tjek er buf.length >= 10 MB (linje 1015). checkUpdate gemmer kun browser_download_url (998). GitHubs API returnerer allerede size og digest for hvert asset.
fix: Gem asset.size og asset.digest i app.update. I applyUpdate tjekkes længde og sha256, før .new skrives. Mangler digest, falder koden tilbage til størrelsestjekket.
evidence: Hentet releases/latest én gang: LoL-Rune-Helper.exe har size 87271936 og digest sha256:18acac5b61a50e97...efb. Den matcher `shasum -a 256 dist/release/LoL-Rune-Helper.exe` lokalt. Koden ved lol-helper.js:995-998 og 1012-1016 bekræfter, at der ikke er andre tjek. Severity sat ned til low: download sker over HTTPS fra GitHub, res.ok tjekkes (1013), og en afkortet body får normalt arrayBuffer() til at fejle. Tjekket er primært billig ekstra sikring (fx mod et forkert asset uploadet under det rigtige navn).

title: Fejlede opdateringer er næsten usynlige, og en .new-fil på 87 MB kan blive liggende
problem: /api/update svarer 200 før applyUpdate (2014-2015), og fejl går kun til log() (2017). Fejler fs.rmSync(.old) (1022) eller renameSync(exe, .old) (1023), bliver ${exe}.new skrevet ved 1017 ikke ryddet op. Banneret har intet fejlfelt (viewModel 1759).
fix: Gem fejlen i app.updateError og vis den i banneret. Ryd .new op i en try/catch omkring trinnene efter writeFileSync.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1017-1029 (ingen oprydning af .new ved fejl ved 1022/1023), 2011-2019, 1759. Om OneDrive eller Defender faktisk giver EPERM på Windows er ikke verificeret.

title: update.test.js dækker kun den vellykkede vej og README siger forkert interval
problem: Testen serverer den samme binær som 'ny version' (linje 26 og 35) og tester kun den vellykkede vej. Der er ingen test af 404, en for lille fil, rollback, nedbrud efter start eller dobbeltklik, og ingen kørsel på Windows. README.md:28 siger 'hver 6. time', men koden tjekker hver time (lol-helper.js:2278) plus når vinduet åbnes (1974).
fix: Tilføj tests for fejlvejene, kør testen én gang på Windows-pc'en, og ret README til 'ved start, hver time og når vinduet åbnes'.
evidence: test/update.test.js:15-60 læst: binary = readFileSync(HELPER_BIN) serveres som asset. Testens assert-linjer handler om pid-skift og den vellykkede vej. README.md:28 ('hver 6. time') modsiger lol-helper.js:2278 ('hver time'). At testen aldrig har kørt på Windows bygger på projektbeskrivelsen og er ikke selvstændigt verificeret.

title: Windows: den nye version starter i et nyt, ikke-minimeret konsolvindue, og loggen ender ingen steder
problem: spawn(exe, ['--updated'], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }) uden windowsHide. Ifølge Node-dokumentationen får et detached barn på Windows sin egen konsol. Autostart-genvejen bruger WindowStyle=7 (minimeret, 1842), men den gælder ikke efter en opdatering. Med stdio 'ignore' bliver output ikke gemt nogen steder.
fix: På win32 sendes stdout/stderr til en logfil i APP_DIR. Start eventuelt via `cmd /c start "" /min`. Afprøv på Windows.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1031 og 1842 læst. Adfærden (nyt konsolvindue, fokus over League) afhænger af Windows og af hvordan SEA-binæren er bygget (console-subsystem). Det er ikke testet, fordi programmet aldrig har kørt på Windows. Derfor kun plausible.

title: Start-item callout can name the general build's start before the matchup plan is ready, then the overlay switches
problem: analyzeLive (and through it starterAdvice) runs before ensurePlan in updateLive. If no plan exists for the live opponent, starterAdvice falls back to the most popular general start. announce() speaks it once (starterAnnounced=true). When the asynchronous plan arrives, the overlay can show a different matchup start, and no correction is spoken.
fix: Delay the 'start' callout until the plan for the current opponent is ready or has failed, with a time fallback. Or re-announce once if starter.items changes before the first purchase.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1541-1547: analyzeLive runs before ensurePlan. lol-helper.js:1270: starterAdvice(build, plan, ...). lol-helper.js:1281-1284: the matchup start is used only if plan.matchupBuild exists and has play >= MATCHUP_MIN_GAMES, otherwise the general start. lol-helper.js:1489-1493: the start callout is said once. lol-helper.js:495-504: buildPlan is asynchronous and keyed by planKey. The callout only diverges when (a) the champion-select plan key differs from the live opponent, or the plan was not finished, and (b) the matchup start has enough games and differs from the general start. When champion select built the same plan, there is no issue. This is real-world dependent, so severity is lowered to low.

title: Browser beep can be silent forever: AudioContext created without a user gesture and never resumed
problem: beep() lazily creates an AudioContext from inside the SSE onmessage handler, not from a user gesture, and nothing ever calls resume(). If the page has had no user activation, Chrome/Edge create the context suspended, and because it is cached every later beep is silent too. openOverlay only creates a context when audio === null, so it cannot repair a suspended one. The Bip toggle does not touch audio either.
fix: In beep(), call audio.resume() when audio.state === 'suspended'. Add a one-time document pointerdown/keydown listener that creates or resumes the context, and resume it in openOverlay and the Bip button handler.
evidence: gui.html:592-606: `audio = audio || new AudioContext()` with no resume. gui.html:620: `if (audio === null) { audio = new AudioContext() }` skips an existing suspended context. gui.html:690: the Bip button only toggles settings.sound. gui.html:697-705: beep is reached from es.onmessage via trackAffordable. A grep of gui.html for 'resume' finds nothing. The code is verified. The suspended-state behaviour follows Chrome's autoplay policy and was not tested here. It only bites when the first beep fires before any click on the page. If the user opens the Overlay first, the context is created in a gesture and works. Severity lowered to low because the spoken voice covers the same event.

title: Overlay 'flash' for a newly affordable item is cut off after about 2 s because the overlay is rebuilt every tick
problem: justAffordable is computed only against the previous SSE message. A live update with a changed gameTime is broadcast every 2 s, and renderOverlay replaces the whole PiP body. On the next tick the row loses the 'flash' class and the new node has no animation. The 3x1.2 s (3.6 s) animation is therefore cut at about 2 s or less.
fix: Keep a per-id flashUntil timestamp (for example now + 4 s) and apply the 'flash' class while it has not expired.
evidence: gui.html:671-678: trackAffordable sets justAffordable = now minus the previous affordable set. gui.html:697-704: the lastJson dedupe does not suppress messages, because gameTime changes every tick, and each message calls renderOverlay. gui.html:660-665: replaceChildren rebuilds all nodes. gui.html:128: `animation: flash 1.2s ease-out 3`. lol-helper.js:1549: updateLive calls broadcast() every tick, and the live loop waits 2000 ms (lol-helper.js:1553).

title: Control Ward reminder shown on ARAM, where it cannot be bought
problem: The wardTip condition never checks ward.maps[mapNumber]. Control Ward has maps['12'] = false, but the GUI (gui.html:435-437) still shows 'Du har ingen Control Ward (75 g)' on ARAM after 5 minutes. The elixir check two lines below does check the map.
fix: Add && ward.maps[mapNumber] !== false to the wardTip condition.
evidence: DDragon 16.21.1: 2055 Control Ward has maps12 = false. lol-helper.js:1148-1150 has no map check, while line 1153 checks the map for the elixir. mapNumber comes from gameData.mapNumber (1262/1269). Severity lowered to low: the user mains Tryndamere top and Evelynn jungle on Summoner's Rift, so this only shows up in ARAM games.

title: Component suggestion ignores owned sub-components: wrong price, misses the obvious combine
problem: affordablePart filters and sorts parts by list price (dd.items[p].gold), and line 1664 shows that list price. A part whose own sub-part you already own (Aether Wisp when you have Amplifying Tome) is priced too high, so it is either filtered out or ranked below a less useful part.
fix: Use remainingCost(p, owned).cost when filtering and sorting, return that cost, and use it at line 1664.
evidence: DDragon: Lich Bane (3100) is built from [3057 Sheen 900, 3113 Aether Wisp 900, 1026 Blasting Wand]. Aether Wisp is built from 1052 Tome (400) and Sheen from 2022 Glowing Mote (250). In walk(), Wisp is pushed at full price and the Tome is only consumed in the sub-walk, so with 600 g the only part under gold is Glowing Mote (250). With 1000 g, Sheen and Wisp tie at 900 and the stable sort keeps from-order, so Sheen comes first. Line 1664: cost: dd.items[a.part].gold.

title: Voice says 'Råd til X' when buying X needs a sale or swap first
problem: canAfford is cost <= budget (line 1427), and budget includes the sell value of a starter (1422) or of the swapped-out item (1416). announce() builds its set from a.canAfford alone, so the voice says 'Råd til X' even when X can only be bought after selling something.
fix: In announce, filter on a.canAfford && !a.sell && !a.swap, or use a separate phrase for them.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1410-1424 sets budget += sell for swap/sell. Line 1427 pushes canAfford: cost <= budget. Line 1483 uses L.advice.filter(a => a.canAfford) with no sell/swap check, and line 1491 calls speak('afford', `Råd til ${itemName(newAfford[0])}`). The GUI text explains the sale, but the voice does not.

title: 10-minute boots reminder ignores the boots the helper chose for the matchup
problem: bootsTip always uses build.boots[0] (the raw OP.GG most-played boots). In champ select, chooseBoots (644-653) may have chosen Plated Steelcaps or Mercury's for the item set, and that choice is not stored for live use. Part of the claim is wrong: liveAdvice does counter-score boots, because Plated Steelcaps carries the Armor tag and Mercury's the SpellBlock tag.
fix: Store chooseBoots' result (for example on app.rec) and use it for bootsTip, or call chooseBoots with the live enemy summary.
evidence: lol-helper.js:1143 reads build.boots[0] and is called with the raw liveBuild.build (1269). chooseBoots' result is only used in recommend (691-703) and is not stored. DDragon refutes 'Boots have no Armor/SpellBlock tags': 3047 Plated Steelcaps tags [Armor, Boots], 3111 Mercury's tags [Boots, SpellBlock, Tenacity]. Lines 1395/1397 therefore do add score in liveAdvice when Steelcaps/Mercury's are at least 2% in the pool (Tryndamere Steelcaps 3.0%). The contradiction only affects the bootsTip line, so this is plausible, not a full bug.

title: ARAM: Control Ward tip and Control Ward in the item set, but it cannot be bought on Howling Abyss
problem: wardTip has no maps[mapNumber] check, and recommend() always adds 'Forbrug' [2003, 2055], so in ARAM the tip and the item set show an item the shop will not sell.
fix: Add `&& ward.maps[mapNumber] !== false` to wardTip, and filter the 'Forbrug' block by mode or by maps['12'].
evidence: Data Dragon 16.21.1 (fetched): 2055 Control Ward has maps {'11':true,'12':false,'22':false,'30':false}. lol-helper.js:1148-1150 wardTip checks only gold, slots, time and ownership. The mapNumber parameter is available (1138) and is used only for the elixir (1153). lol-helper.js:711 `blocks.push(itemBlock('Forbrug', [2003, 2055]))` is unconditional. Health Potion 2003 is fine on map 12.

title: History mixes ARAM, Arena, Practice Tool, bot and custom games into the per-champion stats
problem: finishGame stores no gameMode, map or account. historyView aggregates per champion over every game, and myChampionPool seeds its pool from the most played champions in history.
fix: Store gameMode, mapNumber and the account in the summary. Skip PRACTICETOOL and TUTORIAL games, and filter historyView and myChampionPool to CLASSIC games for the current account.
evidence: The summary object (943-959) has no mode, map or account fields. L.gameMode exists (1271) but is not saved. historyView (1717-1745) groups by g.champion only. myChampionPool (805-807) counts every history entry. Correction to the scenario: aggregation is per champion, not per champion+role, and CS/min is not aggregated per champion (it only appears in the recent list). So the claim 'Tryndamere TOP ... CS/min diluted' is overstated, but the win rate, KDA and followed share are mixed across modes. Not verified: whether Practice Tool exposes port 2999 data with gameTime >= 300 (likely).

title: URF and other non-SR modes get ranked Summoner's Rift builds although OP.GG has a urf endpoint
problem: getBuild maps only 'ARAM'. Every other gameMode, URF included, goes to ranked, and with no assigned position it probes MID and then the main role.
fix: Map 'URF' to fetchBuild(region, 'urf', id, 'none'), like ARAM, and log or display when ranked SR data is used for an unknown non-CLASSIC mode.
evidence: lol-helper.js:571 has only the ARAM branch, and 573-575 is the ranked probe when position is falsy. gameMode comes from /lol-gameflow/v1/session (2223-2224). I did not re-fetch the OP.GG urf endpoint (the original reviewer reports a 200). The exact gameMode strings for rotating modes (URF/ARURF) cannot be verified without a real client. The impact is limited to periods when the mode is in rotation.

title: Data Dragon is loaded once and never refreshed, so a helper left running for days keeps old patch data
problem: loadStaticData is only called at line 2261. The hourly interval only runs pruneCache (line 2275). After a patch, dd.items, dd.champions and dd.versions stay on the old patch while OP.GG builds move to the new one. The comment at line 241 says the program can run for days.
fix: Re-check versions.json periodically (hourly or at champ select start). On change, build a fresh dd object and swap it in, so that removed keys go away too.
evidence: grep shows loadStaticData only at lines 195 (definition) and 2261. setInterval at 2275 calls only pruneCache. I lowered the severity to low: a new champion is rare (a few per year), and on a typical patch only some item gold values and recipes change. Most users also restart the PC or the app between patches, though that is unverified.

title: Matchup guide (lane advantage, solo kill, play style) is shown with no sample-size check
problem: fetchMatchupGuide passes lane_advantage_champion, lane_solo_kill_advantage_champion and recommended_play_style through with no sample check. The other paths use MATCHUP_MIN_GAMES=150 (lines 664, 679, 719, 1281). The guide fields go straight to the plan (line 473) and the GUI chip (gui.html:294).
fix: Compute N from data.summoner_spells[].play (or similar) in the same response. Below MATCHUP_MIN_GAMES, drop or flag laneAdvantage/soloKill/playStyle and keep the tip.
evidence: Live MCP call EVELYNN vs LEE_SIN jungle: summoner_spells play=13, core_items play=1 each, counters=[]. It still returned lane_advantage=Lee Sin, solo_kill=Lee Sin, play_style=defensive. The code at lines 351-357 has no game count. Uncertain: OP.GG may compute the advantage fields from a larger or other dataset than the block next to them, so whether the shown value is really based on 13 games is unproven. I lowered severity to low because it is a short-lived early-patch condition.

title: previousPatch returns the NEWER patch when the OP.GG region lags behind Data Dragon
problem: previousPatch takes the first DDragon major.minor that is different from the current one. When OP.GG's meta.version (16.20) is older than DDragon[0] (16.21.1), it returns 16.21. That is a newer and thinner patch, so the 3x check at line 320 practically never passes. The result is an extra wasted request per fetchBuild, and 16.19 is never tried.
fix: Find the index of current in the de-duplicated major.minor list and return the next entry. Return null if it is not found.
evidence: Ran the function copy with versions [16.21.1, 16.20.1, 16.19.1]: previousPatch('16.20') -> '16.21'. Live: DDragon versions[0]=16.21.1, and OP.GG EUW Evelynn(28) jungle meta.version=16.20 with average_stats.play=16229 < THIN_PATCH_GAMES 20000, so line 315 triggers the fallback right now. The impact is extra traffic plus a missed real fallback, not wrong output.

title: Missing or renamed OP.GG fields silently produce stale or empty builds with a misleading 'new patch' note
problem: If summary.average_stats.play is missing, games=0 (< 20000). If the previous-patch response also lacks it, prevGames=0 and 0 >= 0*3 is true, so the previous patch is returned with thinPatch:true. The UI note at lines 1781 and 2134 then says the patch is new. No field validation happens before cachedJson writes the result to disk (lines 284-288).
fix: Validate data.summary and rune_pages/core_items before returning, and throw otherwise so nothing is cached. Require games>0 or that the field exists before taking the thin-patch branch.
evidence: Code read at lines 311-323 and 284-288. The comparison `prevGames >= games * 3` with both 0 evaluates to true. Uncertain trigger: it only happens if OP.GG changes its unofficial schema. A role or champion with genuinely 0 games on both patches would also hit it. I did not observe either live (current responses contain summary.average_stats.play).

title: Memory cache restarts the 6 h TTL on a disk hit, so data can be up to ~12 h old across a patch
problem: On a disk hit, line 279 accepts the file by mtime < 6 h. Line 291 then stores the entry in memory with at: Date.now(), so line 276 keeps it for another 6 h. The maximum age is about 12 h. Keys have no patch version.
fix: Set `at` from the file mtime when the data was served from disk, or store fetchedAt in the JSON.
evidence: lol-helper.js:274-293. buildCache.set(key, {promise, at: Date.now()}) runs regardless of whether the promise resolves from disk. pruneCache (line 263) uses the same `at`. This only matters after a restart. Practical impact is small: worst case about 12 h stale OP.GG stats.

title: No Glory tracking for Dark Seal/Mejai's (own state, allowed, computable from the kill feed)
problem: Nothing in the code tracks Glory. trackGame (902-922) only logs completed items, so the Dark Seal purchase (not completed) is not even recorded in g.buys, which contradicts the reviewer's premise. The stack count is already shown in-game on the item icon, so the added value is modest.
fix: If wanted: count your own takedowns from ChampionKill events (KillerName/Assisters) after Dark Seal shows up in me.itemIds, subtract on death, label it '(estimat)'. The Glory per takedown is not in DDragon (the description says only 'Takedowns grant Glory') and must be verified in-game.
evidence: trackGame 913-916 only pushes isCompleted items. grep for Glory/Mejai finds only buildingMejais (1343). DDragon 16.21.1 1082: 'up to 10. 5 Glory is lost on death', 3041: 'up to 25 ... 10 lost ... 10% Move Speed at 10 or higher'. The number per takedown is missing. Lowered to low because the game already shows the stacks.

title: Missing own level-6 callout ('camouflage + R ready') for Evelynn
problem: The only level-related voice line is 'Level op: X' when skill.next is set, which requires unspent > 0 (1208). Nothing reacts to your own level reaching 6. The research doc lists it as feature #3 (own state, allowed).
fix: In announce, store the previous L.me.level in app.voice and speak 'Level 6' (+ ' - camouflage' for Evelynn) once when it crosses 6. Own level only.
evidence: Checked announce 1481-1508 and line 1208. The reviewer's 'auto-level-up' scenario is doubtful (LoL has no auto skill-up). But a point spent within the ~2 s poll is realistic, and then 'Level op: R' never fires either way.

title: Oracle Lens / control ward awareness (from TAB) is missing, even though it is Evelynn's main counter
problem: livePlayer puts every item, the trinket included, into itemIds (1086-1087), but no code checks enemy 3364 or 2055. grep finds 2055 only in your own ward tip (1148-1159) and the item set. This is research-doc feature #5 (gray zone, opt-in).
fix: Add an opt-in, text-only fact line in the plan/scoreboard listing the enemies with Oracle Lens (3364) or Control Ward (2055), shown only for camouflage/stealth champions. No voice by default.
evidence: grep 'Oracle|3364|Camouflage' across lol-helper.js and gui.html: no hits. The 2055 hits are only lines 711 and 1148-1159 and 1641, all about your own inventory.

title: Matchup win rate is shown as a big number even with very few games (Skarner: 84 games)
problem: matchupStats (564-567) has no minimum. The plan header shows the WR at 18px (gui.html:291), and recommend adds a 'Mod X: Y% WR' note (677) without the MATCHUP_MIN_GAMES check. Partly mitigated: gui.html:292 shows 'Din win rate i N kampe' right under it, and the note at 677 includes the game count. The Skarner example does not reproduce with the default region GLOBAL: 538 games, 50.7%.
fix: Below MATCHUP_MIN_GAMES (or a CI-based threshold), gray out the big WR or add 'få kampe'.
evidence: On OP.GG global 16.20 Evelynn jungle, 6 of 59 counters have under 150 games (124-141 games, WR 0.47-0.56). Skarner (113) has play 538, win 273. The reviewer's 84-game figure probably comes from a different region or patch. The default region is 'GLOBAL' (line 27).

title: Item settet foreslår komponenter (QSS, B. F. Sword, Executioner's) i 'Mod deres hold' og 'Situationelle items'
problem: counterItems (624-640) og late (709) tager ids fra last_items/core_items uden isCompleted-filter. OP.GG's last_items for Tryndamere TOP indeholder komponenter.
fix: Filtrer pool og late med isCompleted(dd.items[id]), som liveAdvice gør.
evidence: OP.GG GLOBAL TOP 16.21 last_items: B. F. Sword 9,97%, Executioner's Calling 3,74%, Serrated Dirk 2,80%, Tiamat 1,25%, Quicksilver Sash 0,93%. Alle har into.length>0 i DDragon. Jeg har fulgt late (709) med used = core + boots + alt-cores og fået listen BotRK, Profane, Collector, B. F. Sword, Endless Hunger, Executioner's, Hullbreaker, Kraken, altså med to komponenter. I counterItems kommer Wit's End (1,25%) på 16.21 før QSS i SpellBlock-rækkefølgen, så 'Mercurial, QSS' afhænger af 16.20-rækkefølgen. Fejlen i sig selv er bekræftet.
